title.zh: 卷三百十八 列傳第二百〇六 廣西土司二
title.raw: 卷三百十八 列傳第二百〇六 廣西土司二 Volume 318 Biographies 206: Guangxi Tribal Headmen 2

sentences.zh: 太平，漢屬交阯，號麗江。

translations.literal: Taiping, in Han times belonged to Jiaozhi, and was called Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping had belonged to Jiaozhi under the Han and was known as Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 唐為羈縻州，隸邕州都督府。

translations.literal: Under Tang it was a jimi prefecture, subordinate to the Yong Prefecture Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it became a jimi prefecture under the Yongzhou Area Command.

sentences.zh: 宋平嶺南，於左、右二江溪峒立五寨。

translations.literal: When Song pacified Lingnan, it established five stockades among the stream-cave settlements of the Left and Right Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: After the Song pacified Lingnan, they established five stockades among the stream-and-cave settlements along the Left and Right Rivers.

sentences.zh: 其一曰太平，與古萬、遷隆、永平、橫山四寨各領州、縣、峒，屬邕州建武軍節度。

translations.literal: One of these was called Taiping; together with the four stockades of Guwan, Qianlong, Yongping, and Hengshan, each administered prefectures, counties, and cave settlements, and all were under the Jianwu Army command of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: One of these was Taiping; together with the stockades of Guwan, Qianlong, Yongping, and Hengshan, each governed its own prefectures, counties, and cave settlements, all under the Jianwu Army command of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元仍為五寨。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it remained the five stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan the five stockades remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 後廢，乃置太平路於麗江。

translations.literal: Later they were abolished, and the Taiping Circuit was then established at Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: They were later abolished, and the Taiping Circuit was established at Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，征南將軍廖永忠下廣西，左江太平土官黃英衍等遣使賫印詣平章楊璟降。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the southern expedition general Liao Yongzhong entered Guangxi; the Left River Taiping tribal official Huang Yingyan and others sent envoys bearing seals to surrender to the chief minister Yang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the southern expedition general Liao Yongzhong marched into Guangxi; Huang Yingyan and other tribal officials of Taiping on the Left River sent envoys bearing their seals to surrender to Chief Minister Yang Jing.

sentences.zh: 璟還自廣海，帝問黃、岑二氏所轄情形。

translations.literal: When Jing returned from Guanghai, the emperor asked about the territories governed by the Huang and Cen clans.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Jing returned from Guanghai, the emperor asked about the territories held by the Huang and Cen clans.

sentences.zh: 璟言：「蠻僚頑獷，散則為民，聚則為盜，難以文治，當臨之以兵，彼始畏服。」

translations.literal: Yang Jing replied, "The Man and Liao are stubborn and unruly; scattered they live as ordinary people, gathered they turn to banditry. Civil rule alone will not suffice; only when confronted with military force will they submit in fear."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jing replied, "The Man and Liao are stubborn and unruly; scattered they live as ordinary people, gathered they turn to banditry. Civil rule alone will not suffice; only when confronted with military force will they submit in fear."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「蠻瑤性習雖殊，然其好生惡死之心，未嘗不同。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Although the natures and customs of the Man and Yao differ, their desire to live and aversion to death are never different.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Though the Man and Yao differ in temperament and custom, their desire to live and dread of death are the same.

sentences.zh: 若撫之以安靖，待之以誠，諭之以理，彼豈有不從化者哉。」

translations.literal: If one pacifies them with tranquility, treats them with sincerity, and instructs them with reason, how could there be any who would not submit to transformation?"
translations.idiomatic: If we pacify them with calm assurance, treat them with sincerity, and instruct them with reason, how could any fail to accept our guidance?"

sentences.zh: 遣中書照磨蘭以權賫詔，往諭左、右兩江溪峒官民曰：「朕惟武功以定天下，文德以化遠人，此古先哲王威德並施，遐邇鹹服者也。

translations.literal: He dispatched the Secretariat proofreader Lan Yiquan to carry an edict and go to instruct the officials and people of the stream-cave settlements of the Left and Right Rivers, saying: "I consider that martial achievement establishes the realm and civil virtue transforms distant peoples—this is how the sage kings of old applied both authority and virtue, and near and far alike submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Lan Yiquan, proofreader of the Secretariat, to carry an edict and announce to the officials and people of the stream-and-cave settlements along the Left and Right Rivers: "I hold that martial achievement establishes the realm and civil virtue transforms distant peoples—this is how the sage kings of old applied both might and grace, winning submission from near and far alike.

sentences.zh: 眷茲兩江，地邊南僥，風俗質樸。

translations.literal: Regarding these two rivers, the land borders the southern frontier, and the customs are simple and plain.
translations.idiomatic: These two river regions lie on the southern frontier, and their customs are plain and unadorned.

sentences.zh: 自唐、宋以來，黃、岑二氏代居其間，世亂則保境土，世治則修職貢，良由其審時知幾，故能若此。

translations.literal: Since Tang and Song times, the Huang and Cen clans have held sway there in succession; in ages of disorder they preserved their territories, and in ages of order they maintained tribute duties—truly because they discerned the times and knew the turning points, they were able to do thus.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang and Song times the Huang and Cen clans had held sway there in turn: in troubled times they preserved their territories, in peaceful times they maintained tribute duties—because they read the times and knew when to adapt, they were able to endure thus.

sentences.zh: 頃者，朕命將南征，八閩克靖，兩廣平定。

translations.literal: Recently I ordered generals on a southern campaign; the Eight Min were pacified, and the Two Guangs were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Recently I dispatched generals on a southern campaign; the Eight Min were pacified and the Two Guangs brought to order.

sentences.zh: 爾等不煩師旅，奉印來歸，向慕之誠，良足嘉尚。

translations.literal: You did not trouble our armies and troops, but came bearing seals to submit; your sincere admiration is truly worthy of praise.
translations.idiomatic: You came forward with your seals without need of military compulsion; your sincere desire to submit is truly commendable.

sentences.zh: 今特遣使往諭，爾其克慎乃心，益懋厥職，宣布朕意，以安居民。」

translations.literal: Now I specially send an envoy to instruct you; you must carefully guard your hearts, redouble your duties, proclaim my intent, and thereby settle the people."
translations.idiomatic: I now send this envoy to instruct you: guard your hearts carefully, redouble your efforts in duty, proclaim my intent, and thereby bring peace to the people."

sentences.zh: 以權至廣西衛，鎮撫彭宗、萬戶劉維善以兵護送。

translations.literal: When Yiquan reached the Guangxi Guard, the pacification commissioner Peng Zong and battalion commander Liu Weishan escorted him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Lan Yiquan reached the Guangxi Guard, Pacification Commissioner Peng Zong and Battalion Commander Liu Weishan escorted him with troops.

sentences.zh: 將抵兩江，適來賓洞蠻寇掠楊家寨居民。

translations.literal: As they were about to reach the Two Rivers, it happened that Man from Laibin Cave raided the residents of Yangjia Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: As they were nearing the Two Rivers, Man raiders from Laibin Cave happened to be plundering the residents of Yangjia Stockade.

sentences.zh: 以權謂彭宗等曰：「奉詔遠來，欲以安民，今見賊不擊，何以庇民？」

translations.literal: Lan Yiquan said to Peng Zong and the others, "I came from afar on imperial command to bring peace to the people. If I see bandits and do not strike them, how can I protect those I was sent to shelter?"
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yiquan said to Peng Zong and the others, "I came from afar on imperial command to bring peace to the people. If I see bandits and do not strike them, how can I protect those I was sent to shelter?"

sentences.zh: 乃督宗等擊之。

translations.literal: He then directed Zong and the others to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: He then directed Peng Zong and the others to attack them.

sentences.zh: 賊敗走，遂安輯其地，兩江之民由是懾服。

translations.literal: The bandits were defeated and fled; he then settled and pacified the region, and the people of the Two Rivers submitted in awe from this.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were defeated and fled; he then pacified the region, and the people of the Two Rivers submitted in awe.

sentences.zh: 二年，黃英衍遣使奉表貢馬，乃改為太平府。

translations.literal: In the second year, Huang Yingyan sent envoys presenting a memorial and tribute horses; it was then changed to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Huang Yingyan sent envoys with a memorial and tribute horses, and the region was redesignated Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以英衍為知府，世襲。

translations.literal: Yingyan was appointed prefect, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yingyan was appointed prefect, with the office to pass down through his line.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，崇善縣土知縣趙暹謀廣地界，遂招納亡叛，攻左州，執故土官，奪其印，殺其母，大肆擄掠，占據村洞四十余所。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, the Chongshan County tribal magistrate Zhao Xian plotted to expand his borders; he then recruited fugitives and rebels, attacked Zuozhou, seized the former tribal official, took his seal, killed his mother, carried out great-scale plunder, and occupied more than forty villages and caves.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande, Zhao Xian, the tribal magistrate of Chongshan County, sought to expand his territory. He recruited fugitives and rebels, attacked Zuozhou, seized the former tribal official, took his seal, killed his mother, plundered on a large scale, and occupied more than forty villages and cave settlements.

sentences.zh: 造火器，建旗幟，僭稱王，署偽官，流劫州縣。

translations.literal: He made firearms, raised banners and flags, presumptuously styled himself king, appointed false officials, and raided prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He manufactured firearms, raised banners and flags, presumptuously styled himself king, appointed false officials, and raided prefectures and counties at will.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝命總兵官顧興祖會廣西三司剿捕。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor ordered the regional commander Gu Xingzu to join with the three offices of Guangxi in suppressing and capturing them.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, the emperor ordered Regional Commander Gu Xingzu to join with the three provincial offices of Guangxi in suppressing and capturing him.

sentences.zh: 興祖等招之，不服，遣千戶胡廣率兵進。

translations.literal: Xingzu and the others summoned him, but he would not submit; they dispatched battalion commander Hu Guang to lead troops forward.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Xingzu and his colleagues summoned Zhao Xian to surrender, but he refused; they dispatched Battalion Commander Hu Guang to advance with troops.

sentences.zh: 暹扼寨拒守，廣進圍之，紿出所奪各州印，撫諭脅從官民，使復職業。

translations.literal: Xian held the stockade and resisted; Guang advanced and besieged it, tricked out the seals seized from the various prefectures, and comforted and instructed the coerced officials and people, causing them to resume their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xian held his stockade and resisted; Hu Guang advanced and besieged it, recovered the seals seized from the various prefectures, and reassured the coerced officials and people, restoring them to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 暹計窮，從間道遁。

translations.literal: Xian's stratagems exhausted, he escaped by a hidden path.
translations.idiomatic: With his options exhausted, Zhao Xian fled by a hidden path.

sentences.zh: 伏兵邀擊，及其黨皆就擒。

translations.literal: Ambush troops intercepted and struck; he and his followers were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Ambush troops intercepted him, and he and his followers were all captured.

sentences.zh: 時左州土官黃榮亦奏：「蠻人李圓英劫掠居民，偽稱官爵，乞發兵剿捕。」

translations.literal: At the same time Huang Rong, the tribal official of Zuozhou, memorialized, "The Man leader Li Yuanying is plundering the people and falsely claiming official titles; I beg that troops be dispatched to suppress and capture him."
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Huang Rong, the tribal official of Zuozhou, memorialized, "The Man leader Li Yuanying is plundering the people and falsely claiming official titles; I beg that troops be dispatched to suppress and capture him."

sentences.zh: 帝謂兵部曰：「蠻民愚獷，或挾私仇忿爭戕殺，來告者必欲深致其罪，未可遽信。

translations.literal: The emperor said to the Ministry of War: "Tribal people are foolish and fierce; sometimes they kill one another in private vendettas and quarrels. Those who come to report invariably wish to bring severe charges; one cannot hastily believe them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Ministry of War, "Tribal peoples are simple and unruly; sometimes they kill one another over private vendettas. Those who come to report invariably seek to bring the heaviest possible charges—we must not believe them hastily.

sentences.zh: 其令鎮遠侯並廣西三司勘實，先遣人招撫，如叛逆果彰，發兵未晚也。」

translations.literal: Order the Marquis of Zhenyuan together with the three offices of Guangxi to investigate the facts; first send men to summon and pacify—if rebellion is truly manifest, sending troops will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: Order the Marquis of Zhenyuan and the three provincial offices of Guangxi to investigate the facts. First send men to summon and pacify him; if rebellion is truly proven, dispatching troops will not be too late."

sentences.zh: 二年斬南寧百戶許善。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Nanning company commander Xu Shan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Nanning company commander Xu Shan was executed.

sentences.zh: 初，善知趙暹謀逆，與之交通。

translations.literal: Initially, Shan knew of Zhao Xian's plot to rebel and maintained contact with him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Xu Shan had known of Zhao Xian's plot to rebel and had maintained contact with him.

sentences.zh: 及總兵官遣善追暹，又受暹馬十匹、銀百兩，故延緩之，冀幸免。

translations.literal: When the regional commander dispatched Shan to pursue Xian, he again received from Xian ten horses and one hundred taels of silver; therefore he delayed, hoping to escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the regional commander dispatched Xu Shan to pursue Zhao Xian, he accepted ten horses and one hundred taels of silver from Zhao Xian and deliberately delayed the pursuit, hoping to escape punishment himself.

sentences.zh: 事覺，下御史，鞫問得實，斬之，余黨皆伏誅。

translations.literal: When the matter was discovered, he was sent to the censorate; interrogation established the facts, and he was executed; the remaining accomplices were all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter came to light he was handed over to the censorate; interrogation established the facts, and he was executed; the remaining accomplices were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 太平領州縣以十數。

translations.literal: Taiping administered more than ten prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping governed more than ten prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 明初，皆以世職授土官，而設流官佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, all were granted hereditary posts to tribal officials, while regular officials were established to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Ming dynasty, hereditary tribal offices were granted to local headmen, with regular officials appointed to assist them.

sentences.zh: 太平州，舊名瓠陽，為西原、農峒地。

translations.literal: Taiping Prefecture was formerly named Huyang and was territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Prefecture was formerly named Huyang and was territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong.

sentences.zh: 唐為波州，宋隸太平寨，元隸太平路。

translations.literal: In the Tang it was Bozhou; in the Song it belonged to Taiping Stockade, and in the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tang it was Bozhou; in the Song it belonged to Taiping Stockade, and in the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官李以忠歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Li Yizhong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Li Yizhong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.

sentences.zh: 鎮遠州，舊名古隴，宋置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan Prefecture, formerly called Gulong, was established in Song and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan Prefecture, formerly called Gulong, was established under the Song and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官趙勝昌歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Zhao Shengchang submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Zhao Shengchang submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 茗盈州，宋置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Mingying Prefecture was established in Song and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mingying Prefecture was established under the Song and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官李鐵釘歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Li Tieding submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Li Tieding submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 安平州，舊名安山，亦西原、農峒地。

translations.literal: Anping Prefecture, formerly called Anshan, was also land of the Xiyuan and Nong cave settlements.
translations.idiomatic: Anping Prefecture, formerly called Anshan, was also territory of the Xiyuan and Nong cave settlements.

sentences.zh: 唐置波州，宋析為安平州，元隸太平路。

translations.literal: Tang established Bo Prefecture; Song divided it to form Anping Prefecture; under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Bo Prefecture; the Song divided it to form Anping Prefecture; under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官李郭佑歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Li Guoyou submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Li Guoyou submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 思同州，舊名永寧，為西原地，唐置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Sitong Prefecture was formerly named Yongning, was Xiyuan territory, and was established in the Tang under Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sitong Prefecture was formerly named Yongning, was Xiyuan territory, and was established in the Tang under Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋隸太平寨。

translations.literal: In the Song it belonged to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song it belonged to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官黃克嗣歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之，屬太平府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Huang Kesi submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him; it belonged to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Huang Kesi submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him; it belonged to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十八年，省入永康州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Wanli, it was abolished and merged into Yongkang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Wanli, it was abolished and merged into Yongkang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 養利州，元屬太平路。

translations.literal: Yangli Prefecture under Yuan belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yangli Prefecture belonged to Taiping Circuit under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官趙日泰歸附，授知州，以次傳襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Zhao Ritai submitted; he was granted prefect, with succession passing in order.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Zhao Ritai submitted; he was granted the post of prefect, with succession passing in order through his line.

sentences.zh: 宣德間，稍侵其鄰境，肆殺掠。

translations.literal: During Xuande, he gradually encroached on neighboring borders and wantonly killed and plundered.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xuande reign he gradually encroached on neighboring territory and wantonly killed and plundered.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三年討平之，改流官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli he was suppressed and pacified; the post was changed to a regular official.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wanli he was suppressed and pacified, and the post was converted to a regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 萬承州，舊名萬陽。

translations.literal: Wancheng Prefecture was formerly called Wanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wancheng Prefecture was formerly called Wanyang.

sentences.zh: 唐置萬承、萬形二州。

translations.literal: Tang established the two prefectures of Wancheng and Wanxing.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established the two prefectures of Wancheng and Wanxing.

sentences.zh: 宋省萬形，隸太平寨。

translations.literal: Song abolished Wanxing; it was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song abolished Wanxing, and the prefecture was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官許郭安歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Xu Guo'an submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Xu Guo'an submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，郭安從征交阯，死於軍，子永誠襲。

translations.literal: During Yongle, Guo'an followed the campaign against Jiaozhi and died in the army; his son Yongcheng succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongle reign Xu Guo'an joined the campaign against Jiaozhi and died in service; his son Yongcheng succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 全茗州，舊名連岡，為西原地，宋置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Quanming Prefecture, formerly called Liangang, was Xiyuan territory; it was established in Song and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Quanming Prefecture, formerly called Liangang, was Xiyuan territory; it was established under the Song and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官李添慶歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Li Tianqing submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Li Tianqing submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 結安州，舊名營周，亦西原、農峒地。

translations.literal: Jie’an Prefecture was formerly named Yingzhou and was also territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong.
translations.idiomatic: Jie’an Prefecture was formerly named Yingzhou and was also territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong.

sentences.zh: 宋置結安峒，隸太平寨。

translations.literal: In the Song, Jie’an Cave was established and belonged to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song, Jie’an Cave was established and belonged to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元改州，屬太平路。

translations.literal: In the Yuan it was changed into a prefecture and belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was changed into a prefecture and belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官張仕榮歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhang Shirong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhang Shirong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.

sentences.zh: 龍英州，舊名英山，宋為峒。

translations.literal: Longying Prefecture was formerly named Yingshan and in the Song was a cave district.
translations.idiomatic: Longying Prefecture was formerly named Yingshan and in the Song was a cave district.

sentences.zh: 元改州，屬太平路。

translations.literal: In the Yuan it was changed into a prefecture and belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was changed into a prefecture and belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官李世賢歸附，授世襲知州，割上懷地益其境，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Li Shixian submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate; Shanghuai land was cut off to enlarge its territory, and a regular-official registrar was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Li Shixian submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate; Shanghuai land was cut off to enlarge its territory, and a regular-official registrar was established to assist him.

sentences.zh: 結倫州，舊名邦兜，亦西原、農峒地。

translations.literal: Jielun Prefecture, formerly called Bangdou, was also land of the Xiyuan and Nong cave settlements.
translations.idiomatic: Jielun Prefecture, formerly called Bangdou, was also territory of the Xiyuan and Nong cave settlements.

sentences.zh: 宋置結安峒，隸太平寨。

translations.literal: Song established Jie'an Cave, subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song established Jie'an Cave, subordinate to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元改州，屬太平路。

translations.literal: Yuan changed it to a prefecture, belonging to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan converted it to a prefecture under Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，峒長馮萬傑歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, the cave chief Feng Wanjie submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongwu the cave chief Feng Wanjie submitted; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 都結州，元屬太平路，土官農姓。

translations.literal: Dujie Prefecture under Yuan belonged to Taiping Circuit; the tribal official was of the Nong surname.
translations.idiomatic: Dujie Prefecture belonged to Taiping Circuit under the Yuan; the tribal official was of the Nong clan.

sentences.zh: 洪武初內附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu he submitted internally; he was granted hereditary prefect, and a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu he submitted to the dynasty; he was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 上、下凍州，舊名凍江。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Dong Prefecture were formerly named Dongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and Lower Dong Prefecture were formerly named Dongjiang.

sentences.zh: 宋置凍州。

translations.literal: In the Song, Dong Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song, Dong Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 元分上、下凍二州，尋合為一，屬龍州萬戶府。

translations.literal: In the Yuan it was divided into Upper and Lower Dong prefectures, but they were soon combined into one and belonged to the Longzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was divided into Upper and Lower Dong prefectures, but they were soon combined into one and belonged to the Longzhou Ten-Thousand-Household Office.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官趙貼從歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之，屬太平府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhao Tiecong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him; it belonged to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhao Tiecong submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him; it belonged to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貼從死，子福瑀襲。

translations.literal: When Tiecong died, his son Fuyu succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: When Tiecong died, his son Fuyu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年從征交阯，死於軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle, Fuyu followed the campaign against Jiaozhi and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle, Fuyu followed the campaign against Jiaozhi and died in the army.

sentences.zh: 思城州，亦西原、農峒地，唐置州。

translations.literal: Sicheng Prefecture was also territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong, and was established as a prefecture in the Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Sicheng Prefecture was also territory of Xiyuan and Nongdong, and was established as a prefecture in the Tang.

sentences.zh: 宋分為上、下思城二州，隸太平寨。

translations.literal: In the Song it was divided into Upper and Lower Sicheng prefectures, belonging to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song it was divided into Upper and Lower Sicheng prefectures, belonging to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元至正間，並為一，屬太平路。

translations.literal: During the Zhizheng era of the Yuan, they were combined into one and belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhizheng era of the Yuan, they were combined into one and belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，土官趙雄傑歸附，授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhao Xiongjie submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the native official Zhao Xiongjie submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefectural magistrate, with a regular-official registrar established to assist him.

sentences.zh: 永康州，宋置縣，隸遷隆寨。

translations.literal: Yongkang Prefecture: Song established it as a county, subordinate to Qianlong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Yongkang Prefecture was established as a county under the Song and subordinate to Qianlong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平路，土官楊姓。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit; the tribal official was of the Yang surname.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was subordinate to Taiping Circuit; the tribal official was of the Yang clan.

sentences.zh: 成化八年，其裔孫楊雄傑糾合峒賊二千余人，入宣化縣劫掠，且偽署官職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chenghua, his descendant Yang Xiongjie gathered more than two thousand cave bandits, entered Xuanhua County to plunder, and moreover falsely appointed official posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Chenghua his descendant Yang Xiongjie rallied more than two thousand cave bandits, raided Xuanhua County, and presumptuously appointed official titles.

sentences.zh: 總兵官趙輔捕誅之，因改流官。

translations.literal: The regional commander Zhao Fu captured and executed him; the post was therefore changed to a regular official.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Zhao Fu captured and executed him, and the post was converted to a regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十八年升為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Wanli it was promoted to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Wanli it was promoted to prefectural status.

sentences.zh: 左州，舊名左陽，唐置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Zuozhou, formerly called Zuoyang, was established in Tang and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zuozhou, formerly called Zuoyang, was established under the Tang and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋隸古萬寨。

translations.literal: Under Song it was subordinate to Guwan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was subordinate to Guwan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬太平路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官黃勝爵歸附，授世襲知州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Huang Shengjue submitted; he was granted hereditary prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Huang Shengjue submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefect.

sentences.zh: 再傳，子孫爭襲，相仇殺。

translations.literal: After two successions, descendants fought over succession and killed one another in mutual enmity.
translations.idiomatic: After two successions, descendants fought over the inheritance and killed one another in vendetta.

sentences.zh: 成化十三年改流官。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chenghua it was changed to a regular official.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Chenghua the post was converted to a regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 羅陽縣，舊名福利，陀陵縣，舊名駱陀，皆宋置。

translations.literal: Luoyang County, formerly called Fuli; Tuoling County, formerly called Luotuo—all were established in Song.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang County, formerly called Fuli, and Tuoling County, formerly called Luotuo, were both established under the Song.

sentences.zh: 元隸太平。

translations.literal: Under Yuan they were subordinate to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan they were subordinate to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官黃宣、黃富歸附，並授世襲知縣，設流官典史佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal officials Huang Xuan and Huang Fu submitted; both were granted hereditary county magistrate, and regular official recorders were established to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal officials Huang Xuan and Huang Fu submitted; both were granted hereditary county magistrate posts, with regular official recorders appointed to assist them.

sentences.zh: 思明，唐置州，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Siming was established as a prefecture in Tang and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Siming was established as a prefecture under the Tang and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋隸太平寨。

translations.literal: Under Song it was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元改思明路。

translations.literal: Yuan changed it to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan redesignated it as Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，改為府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu it was converted to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年，土官黃忽都遣使貢馬及方物。

translations.literal: In the second year, the tribal official Huang Hudu sent envoys presenting tribute horses and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the tribal official Huang Hudu sent envoys with tribute horses and local products.

sentences.zh: 詔以忽都為思明府知府，世襲。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Hudu as prefect of Siming Prefecture, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Huang Hudu prefect of Siming Prefecture, with the office to pass down through his line.

sentences.zh: 十五年，忽都復遣其弟祿政奉表來貢，詔賜鈔錠。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Hudu again sent his younger brother Luzheng presenting a memorial in tribute; an edict granted paper money ingots.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Huang Hudu again sent his younger brother Luzheng with a memorial and tribute; the court granted him paper money ingots.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，忽都子黃廣平遣思州知州黃誌銘率屬部，偕十五州土官李圓泰等來朝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Hudu's son Huang Guangping dispatched Sizhou Prefect Huang Zhiming leading subordinate departments, together with the tribal officials of fifteen prefectures including Li Yuantai, to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Hudu's son Huang Guangping dispatched Sizhou Prefect Huang Zhiming leading his subordinates, together with tribal officials from fifteen prefectures including Li Yuantai, to attend court.

sentences.zh: 明年，廣平以服闋，遣知州黃忠奉表貢馬及方物。

translations.literal: The next year, Guangping, his mourning period completed, dispatched Prefect Huang Zhong presenting a memorial and tribute horses and local products.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, his mourning period completed, Guangping dispatched Prefect Huang Zhong with a memorial, tribute horses, and local products.

sentences.zh: 詔廣平襲職，賜冠帶襲衣，及文綺十匹、鈔百錠。

translations.literal: An edict granted Guangping succession to the office, bestowed cap, belt, and ceremonial robe, plus ten bolts of patterned silk and one hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: An edict confirmed Guangping's succession to the office and granted him cap, belt, and ceremonial robe, along with ten bolts of patterned silk and one hundred ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，憑祥洞巡檢高祥奏，思明州知州門三貴謀殺思明府知府黃廣平，廣平覺而殺之，乃以病死聞於朝，所言不實。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Pingxiang Cave inspector Gao Xiang memorialized that Siming Prefecture Magistrate Men Sangu plotted to kill Siming Prefecture Prefect Huang Guangping; Guangping discovered it and killed him, yet reported to the court that he had died of illness—the statement was untrue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Pingxiang Cave Inspector Gao Xiang memorialized that Siming Prefecture Magistrate Men Sangu had plotted to kill Siming Prefect Huang Guangping; Guangping discovered the plot and killed him, yet reported to the court that he had died of illness—the account was false.

sentences.zh: 詔逮廣平鞫之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Guangping seized and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huang Guangping seized and brought to trial.

sentences.zh: 既至，帝謂刑部曰：「蠻寇相殺，性習固然，獨廣平不以實言，故繩以法。

translations.literal: When he arrived, the emperor said to the Ministry of Punishments: "Tribal bandits killing one another is naturally their custom; only Guangping did not speak truthfully, therefore he is bound by law.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, the emperor told the Ministry of Punishments, "Tribal leaders killing one another is their custom by nature; it is only because Guangping did not speak truthfully that he must be bound by law.

sentences.zh: 今姑宥之，使其改過。」

translations.literal: For now I pardon him, that he may amend his ways."
translations.idiomatic: For now I pardon him, that he may amend his ways."

sentences.zh: 命給道里費遣還，是後朝貢如例。

translations.literal: He ordered travel expenses given and him sent back; thereafter tribute to court proceeded as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was given travel expenses and sent home; thereafter tribute to court proceeded as before.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，土官黃廣成遣使入貢，因奏言：「本府自故元改思明路軍民總管所，轄左江一路州縣峒寨，東至上思州，南至銅柱。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the tribal official Huang Guangcheng sent envoys to present tribute, and moreover memorialized: "This prefecture, since the former Yuan changed it to the Siming Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration Office, governed the prefectures, counties, cave settlements, and stockades of the Left River route, east to Shangsi Prefecture and south to the Bronze Pillars.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the tribal official Huang Guangcheng sent envoys with tribute and memorialized: "Since the Yuan dynasty converted this prefecture to the Siming Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration Office, it has governed the prefectures, counties, cave settlements, and stockades along the Left River route, east to Shangsi Prefecture and south to the Bronze Pillars.

sentences.zh: 元兵征交阯，去銅柱百里，設永平寨軍民萬戶府，置兵戍守，命交人供其軍餉。

translations.literal: When Yuan troops campaigned against Jiaozhi, one hundred li from the Bronze Pillars they established the Yongping Stockade Military-Civilian Ten-Thousand-Household Office, stationed troops to garrison it, and ordered the Jiao people to supply their military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan troops campaigned against Jiaozhi, they established the Yongping Stockade Military-Civilian Ten-Thousand-Household Office a hundred li from the Bronze Pillars, stationed troops to garrison it, and ordered the people of Jiaozhi to supply their provisions.

sentences.zh: 元季擾亂，交人以兵攻破永平寨，遂越銅柱二百余裏，侵奪思明屬地丘溫、如嶅、慶遠、淵、脫等五縣，逼民附之，以是五縣歲賦皆土官代輸。

translations.literal: In the turmoil of the Yuan end, the Jiao people broke Yongping Stockade by force, then crossed more than two hundred li beyond the Bronze Pillars, seized and occupied the five counties of Qiuwen, Ruyao, Qingyuan, Yuan, and Tuo belonging to Siming, compelled the people to submit to them, and therefore the annual levies of these five counties were all paid on their behalf by the tribal official.
translations.idiomatic: In the turmoil at the end of the Yuan, the people of Jiaozhi broke Yongping Stockade by force, crossed more than two hundred li beyond the Bronze Pillars, and seized the five Siming counties of Qiuwen, Ruyao, Qingyuan, Yuan, and Tuo, compelling the inhabitants to submit to them; thereafter the tribal official paid the annual levies for all five counties on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 前者本府失理於朝，遂致交人侵迫益甚。

translations.literal: Previously this prefecture failed in its dealings with the court, and thus the Jiao people pressed their encroachments ever more severely.
translations.idiomatic: Previously this prefecture had failed in its dealings with the court, and the people of Jiaozhi pressed their encroachments ever more aggressively.

sentences.zh: 及告禮部，任尚書立站於洞登，洞登實思明地，而交阯乃稱屬銅柱界。

translations.literal: When it was reported to the Ministry of Rites, Minister Ren established a station at Dongdeng; Dongdeng was in fact Siming territory, yet Jiaozhi claimed it belonged to the Bronze Pillars boundary.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported to the Ministry of Rites, Minister Ren established a station at Dongdeng—though Dongdeng was actually Siming territory, Jiaozhi claimed it lay within the Bronze Pillars boundary.

sentences.zh: 臣嘗具奏，蒙朝廷遣刑部尚書楊靖核其事，《建武志》尚可考。

translations.literal: Your subject once submitted a full memorial; the court dispatched Minister of Punishments Yang Jing to verify the matter, and the Jianwu Gazetteer can still be consulted.
translations.idiomatic: I once submitted a full memorial on this matter; the court dispatched Minister of Punishments Yang Jing to investigate, and the Jianwu Gazetteer can still be consulted as evidence.

sentences.zh: 乞敕安南，俾還舊封，庶疆域復正，歲賦不虛。」

translations.literal: I beg that an edict be issued commanding Annam to restore the former boundaries, so that the territory may be set right and annual levies no longer go unpaid."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that an edict be issued commanding Annam to restore the former boundaries, so that the territory may be set right and annual levies no longer go unpaid."

sentences.zh: 帝令戶部錄所奏，遣行人陳誠、呂讓往諭安南。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Revenue to record the memorial and dispatched envoys Chen Cheng and Lü Rang to instruct Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Revenue to record the memorial and dispatched envoys Chen Cheng and Lü Rang to instruct Annam.

sentences.zh: 三十年，誠、讓至安南，諭其王陳日焜，令還思明地。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Cheng and Rang reached Annam and instructed its king Chen Rikun to return Siming territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Chen Cheng and Lü Rang reached Annam and instructed King Chen Rikun to return Siming territory.

sentences.zh: 議論往復，久而不決。

translations.literal: Debate went back and forth, and for a long time no decision was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Debate went back and forth for a long time without resolution.

sentences.zh: 以譯者言不達意，復為書曉之。

translations.literal: Because the interpreters' words did not convey the meaning, they wrote a letter to make it clear.
translations.idiomatic: Because the interpreters failed to convey the meaning adequately, they wrote a letter to make the court's position clear.

sentences.zh: 安南終辯論不已，出黃金二錠、白金西錠及沈檀等香以賄，誠卻之。

translations.literal: Annam ultimately would not cease arguing; they produced two ingots of gold, ingots of white metal, and aloeswood and sandalwood incense as bribes, but Cheng refused them.
translations.idiomatic: Annam ultimately refused to cease arguing and offered two ingots of gold, ingots of silver, and aloeswood and sandalwood incense as bribes, but Chen Cheng refused them.

sentences.zh: 安南復咨戶部，無還地意。

translations.literal: Annam again consulted the Ministry of Revenue, showing no intention of returning the land.
translations.idiomatic: Annam again petitioned the Ministry of Revenue, showing no intention of returning the territory.

sentences.zh: 廷臣議其抗命當誅，帝曰：「蠻人怙頑不悛，終必取禍，姑待之。」

translations.literal: Court officials debated that their defiance of orders deserved execution; the emperor said: "The barbarians rely on stubbornness and will not reform; in the end they will bring disaster upon themselves—let us wait for now."
translations.idiomatic: Court officials argued that their defiance of imperial orders deserved punishment, but the emperor said, "These peoples rely on stubbornness and refuse to reform—they will bring disaster upon themselves in the end. Let us wait for now."

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，憑祥巡檢李升言，其地瀕安南，百姓樂業，生齒日繁，請改為縣，以便撫輯，從之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, Pingxiang inspector Li Sheng said that the place bordered Annam, the people were content in their occupations, and the population daily increased; he requested it be changed to a county for easier pacification and control, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle, Pingxiang Inspector Li Sheng reported that the area bordered Annam, the people were prospering in their occupations, and the population was growing daily; he requested that it be converted to a county for easier administration, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以升為知縣，設流官典史一員。

translations.literal: Sheng was appointed county magistrate, and one regular official recorder was established.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng was appointed county magistrate, with one regular official recorder appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 三年，升以新設縣治來朝，貢馬及方物謝恩。

translations.literal: In the third year, Sheng came to court with the newly established county administration and presented tribute horses and local products in gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Li Sheng came to court representing the newly established county and presented tribute horses and local products in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 廣成奏安南侵奪其祿州、西平州永平寨地，請遣使諭還，從之。

translations.literal: Guangcheng memorialized that Annam had seized the territory of Luzhou, Xiping Prefecture, and Yongping Stockade; he requested that envoys be sent to instruct their return, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Guangcheng memorialized that Annam had seized the territories of Luzhou, Xiping Prefecture, and Yongping Stockade, and requested that envoys be dispatched to demand their return; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 九年，免思明稅糧，以廣成言去秋雨水傷稼也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Siming's tax grain was remitted, because Guangcheng said that last autumn rain had damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Siming's tax grain was remitted, as Huang Guangcheng reported that the previous autumn's rains had damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，思明賀天壽節奉表逾期，禮部請罪之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, Siming's congratulatory memorial for the Heavenly Longevity Festival was overdue; the Ministry of Rites requested punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande, Siming's congratulatory memorial for the Heavenly Longevity Festival arrived late; the Ministry of Rites requested that they be punished.

sentences.zh: 帝以遠蠻既至，毋問。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that the distant tribes had arrived after all, ordered no inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, noting that the distant tribes had arrived after all, ordered that no further action be taken.

sentences.zh: 土官知府黃岡奏憑祥歲兇民饑，命發龍州官倉糧振之。

translations.literal: The tribal prefect Huang Gang memorialized that Pingxiang had a bad harvest and the people were starving; an order was issued to distribute grain from the Longzhou official granary for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal prefect Huang Gang memorialized that Pingxiang had suffered a bad harvest and the people were starving; the court ordered grain distributed from the Longzhou official granary for relief.

sentences.zh: 正統七年，岡遺使入貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengtong, Gang sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhengtong, Huang Gang sent envoys to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年，貢解毒藥味，賜鈔錦。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he presented antidotal medicines; paper money and brocade were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he presented antidotal medicines and was granted paper money and brocade.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，岡致仕，以子鈞襲。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai, Gang retired; his son Jun succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingtai Huang Gang retired, and his son Jun succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 岡庶兄都指揮矰欲殺鈞，代以己子。

translations.literal: Gang's elder half-brother, regional commander Zeng, wished to kill Jun and replace him with his own son.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Gang's elder half-brother, Regional Commander Huang Zeng, plotted to kill Jun and install his own son in his place.

sentences.zh: 矰守備潯州，托言征兵思明府，令其子糾眾結營於府三十里外，馳至府，襲殺岡一家，支解岡及鈞，甕葬後圃，仍歸原寨。

translations.literal: Zeng was garrison commander at Xunzhou; under the pretext of conscripting troops for Siming Prefecture, he had his son gather a crowd and establish a camp thirty li outside the prefecture, then galloped to the prefectural seat, launched a surprise attack and killed Gang's entire family, dismembered Gang and Jun, buried them in jars in the rear garden, and returned to his original stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zeng was garrison commander at Xunzhou; under the pretext of conscripting troops for Siming Prefecture, he had his son gather followers and establish a camp thirty li outside the prefectural seat, then galloped in, slaughtered Huang Gang's entire family, dismembered Gang and Jun, buried their remains in jars in the rear garden, and returned to his original stockade.

sentences.zh: 明日，乃入城，詐發哀，遣人報矰捕賊，以掩其跡。

translations.literal: The next day he entered the city, feigned mourning, and sent men to report to Zeng to capture the bandits, so as to cover his tracks.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he entered the city, feigned mourning, and sent men to report to Huang Zeng to hunt down the bandits, covering his tracks.

sentences.zh: 方殺岡時，岡仆福童得免，走憲司訴其事，且以征兵檄為證。

translations.literal: When Gang was being killed, his servant Futong escaped, fled to the provincial administration commission to report the matter, and produced the conscription order as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: When the slaughter occurred, Huang Gang's servant Futong escaped, fled to the provincial administration commission to report the crime, and produced the conscription order as evidence.

sentences.zh: 郡人亦言殺岡一家者，矰父子也。

translations.literal: People of the prefecture also said that those who killed Gang's family were Zeng and his son.
translations.idiomatic: Local people also testified that Huang Zeng and his son were the ones who had killed Huang Gang's family.

sentences.zh: 副總兵武毅以聞，將逮治之。

translations.literal: Deputy regional commander Wu Yi reported it; they were about to arrest and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Regional Commander Wu Yi reported the matter, and authorities were about to arrest and punish them.

sentences.zh: 矰自度禍及，及謀迎合朝廷意，遣千戶袁洪奏永固國本事，請易儲。

translations.literal: Zeng judged that disaster would reach him, and therefore plotted to align with the court's intent; he dispatched battalion commander Yuan Hong to memorialize on securing the foundation of the state and request a change of heir.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zeng saw that disaster was imminent and plotted to win the court's favor; he dispatched Battalion Commander Yuan Hong to memorialize on securing the foundation of the state and request a change of heir.

sentences.zh: 奏入，帝曰：「此天下國家重事，多官其會議以聞。」

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor said, "This is a weighty matter for the realm and the state; let the senior officials confer and report back."
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor said, "This is a weighty matter for the realm and the state; let the senior officials confer and report back."

sentences.zh: 矰為此舉，眾皆驚愕，謂必有受其賂而教之者，或疑侍郎江淵雲。

translations.literal: Zeng's doing this astonished everyone; they said there must have been someone who received bribes and instructed him, and some suspected Vice Minister Jiang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zeng's maneuver astonished everyone; many believed someone had been bribed to instruct him, and some suspected Vice Minister Jiang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 事成，矰得釋罪，且進秩。

translations.literal: When the matter succeeded, Zeng was released from punishment and even promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: When the maneuver succeeded, Huang Zeng was released from punishment and even promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 英宗復辟，矰聞自殺。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong restored the throne, Zeng, upon hearing of it, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong restored the throne, Huang Zeng killed himself upon hearing the news.

sentences.zh: 帝命發棺戮其屍，其子震亦為都督韓雍捕誅。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered his coffin opened and his corpse publicly desecrated; his son Zhen was also captured and executed by regional commander Han Yong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered his coffin opened and his corpse publicly desecrated; his son Zhen was also captured and executed by Regional Commander Han Yong.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年，土知府黃道奏所轄思明州土官孫黃義為族人黃紹所殺，乞發兵捕剿。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Chenghua, the tribal prefect Huang Dao memorialized that Huang Yi, grandson of the Siming Prefecture tribal official under his jurisdiction, had been killed by his clansman Huang Shao; he begged that troops be sent to suppress and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Chenghua the tribal prefect Huang Dao memorialized that Huang Yi, grandson of the Siming Prefecture tribal official under his jurisdiction, had been killed by his clansman Huang Shao, and begged that troops be dispatched to suppress and capture the killer.

sentences.zh: 帝命兩廣守臣區處以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the defending officials of the Two Guangs to handle the matter locally and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the defending officials of the Two Guangs to handle the matter and report back.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年，況村賊黃紹侵占思明、上石、下石三州，復謀殺知府黃道父子。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Hongzhi, the Kuangcun bandit Huang Shao encroached on the three prefectures of Siming, Shangshi, and Xiashi, and again plotted to kill Prefect Huang Dao and his son.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Hongzhi the Kuangcun bandit Huang Shao seized the three prefectures of Siming, Shangshi, and Xiashi and again plotted to kill Prefect Huang Dao and his son.

sentences.zh: 道妻趙氏累訴於朝，且謂屢經委官勘問，俱被賂免，乞發兵誅之。

translations.literal: Dao's wife Lady Zhao repeatedly petitioned the court, saying that repeated commissions to investigate had all been bribed into acquittal; she begged that troops be sent to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Dao's wife Lady Zhao repeatedly petitioned the court, reporting that repeated official investigations had all been bribed into acquittal, and begged that troops be dispatched to execute Huang Shao.

sentences.zh: 十一年，紹集眾數千人焚劫鄉村，據三州，屢撫不下，總鎮請發兵捕剿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Shao gathered several thousand men, burned and plundered villages, and held the three prefectures; repeated pacification efforts failed, and the supreme commander requested troops to suppress and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Huang Shao gathered several thousand followers, burned and plundered villages, and held the three prefectures; repeated pacification efforts failed, and the supreme commander requested troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十一年，以剿平瑤、僮功，命土官知州男黃承祖暫襲本職。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Jiajing, for achievements in suppressing and pacifying the Yao and Zhuang, the tribal prefect Nan Huang Chengzu was ordered to temporarily succeed to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year of Jiajing, for achievements in suppressing the Yao and Zhuang, the tribal prefect Nan Huang Chengzu was granted temporary succession to his original office.

sentences.zh: 隆慶四年，忠州土官黃賢相等據南寧府屬四都地作亂，永康典史李材計誘其黨，縛賢相以降。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Longqing, the Zhongzhou tribal official Huang Xianxiang and others seized the Four Du territory under Nanning Prefecture and rebelled; Yongkang recorder Li Cai devised a stratagem to lure his followers and bound Xianxiang to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Longqing the Zhongzhou tribal official Huang Xianxiang and others seized the Four Du territory under Nanning Prefecture and rebelled; Yongkang Recorder Li Cai devised a stratagem to lure his followers and bound Huang Xianxiang to surrender.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十六年，思明州土官黃拱聖謀奪襲，殺其母兄拱極等五人。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Wanli, the Siming Prefecture tribal official Huang Gongsheng plotted to seize succession and killed his mother, elder brother Gongji, and three others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Wanli the Siming Prefecture tribal official Huang Gongsheng plotted to seize the succession and killed his mother, elder brother Gongji, and three others.

sentences.zh: 而思明知府黃承祖乘亂掠村寨，為之援。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Siming Prefect Huang Chengzu took advantage of the turmoil to plunder villages and stockades, supporting him.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Siming Prefect Huang Chengzu took advantage of the turmoil to plunder villages and stockades, lending Gongsheng his support.

sentences.zh: 按臣請以拱聖及諸兇正法，思明州改屬流府，革承祖冠帶，立功自贖，而追其所掠；

translations.literal: The investigating censor requested that Gongsheng and the other culprits be executed according to law, that Siming Prefecture be transferred to a regular prefecture, that Chengzu's cap and belt be stripped, that he redeem himself through meritorious service, and that what he had plundered be recovered;
translations.idiomatic: The investigating censor requested that Gongsheng and the other culprits be executed according to law, that Siming Prefecture be transferred to regular administration, that Chengzu's cap and belt be stripped and he be required to redeem himself through meritorious service, and that his plunder be recovered;

sentences.zh: 更令族人黃恩護拱極妻許氏撫遺孤世延，待其長官之。

translations.literal: further that clansman Huang En be ordered to protect Gongji's wife Lady Xu in raising the orphaned heir Shiyan, until he came of age to hold office.
translations.idiomatic: further that clansman Huang En be ordered to protect Gongji's widow Lady Xu in raising the orphaned heir Shiyan until he came of age to hold office.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，總督戴耀奏：「思明叛目已擒，土官黃應雷縱仆起釁，棄印而逃，斷難復官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Governor-general Dai Yao memorialized: "The Siming rebel leaders have been captured; the tribal official Huang Yinglei incited his servants to start trouble, abandoned his seal and fled—he can by no means be restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year Governor-general Dai Yao memorialized: "The Siming rebel leaders have been captured; the tribal official Huang Yinglei incited his servants to start trouble, abandoned his seal, and fled—he can by no means be restored to office.

sentences.zh: 黃應宿爭地，殺戮六哨成仇，且系義子，不應襲職。

translations.literal: Huang Yingsu fought over territory, killing across six outposts until enmity was entrenched; moreover he is an adopted son and should not succeed to office.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yingsu fought over territory, killing across six outposts until deep enmity was entrenched; moreover he is an adopted son and should not succeed to office.

sentences.zh: 黃應聘系承祖幼子，人心推戴，似應承襲知府，以存黃氏宗祀。

translations.literal: Huang Yingpin is Chengzu's youngest son; popular sentiment supports him—it seems he should succeed as prefect to preserve the Huang clan's ancestral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yingpin is Chengzu's youngest son and enjoys popular support—it seems he should succeed as prefect to preserve the Huang clan's ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 但年甫七歲，暫令流官同知署府事，待至十五歲，交印接管。

translations.literal: But he is only seven years old; for now let a regular vice prefect administer the prefecture; when he reaches fifteen, the seal shall be handed over for him to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: But he is only seven years old; for now let a regular vice prefect administer the prefecture, and when he reaches fifteen the seal shall be handed over for him to take charge.

sentences.zh: 應雷既廢，不宜同城，應降為土舍，其後永襲土舍，給田養贍，制其出入。

translations.literal: Since Yinglei is deposed, he should not remain in the same city; he should be demoted to tribal retainer, thereafter permanently inheriting that status, granted land for support, and his movements restricted.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yinglei is deposed, he should not remain in the same city; he should be demoted to tribal retainer, permanently inheriting that status, granted land for support, with his movements restricted.

sentences.zh: 應宿仍管故業，俱屬思明府節制。

translations.literal: Yingsu shall still manage his former holdings; both shall be under Siming Prefecture's control.
translations.idiomatic: Yingsu shall still manage his former holdings; both shall remain under Siming Prefecture's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 於府治設教授一員，量給廩生六名，其寄附太平府者，悉歸本學，嗣後續增其祭祀廩餼之用，則地方可安，文教可興。」

translations.literal: An instructor shall be established at the prefectural seat with six stipend students; those attached to Taiping Prefecture shall all return to the local school; thereafter increase the provisions for sacrificial rites, and then the region can be settled and civil culture can flourish."
translations.idiomatic: An instructor shall be established at the prefectural seat with six stipend students; those attached to Taiping Prefecture shall all return to the local school; thereafter increase the provisions for sacrificial rites, and then the region can be settled and civil culture can flourish."

sentences.zh: 詔悉從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved all of these recommendations.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十一年，總督張鏡心疏報土官殺職官思明州黃日章、黃德誌等，鼓眾叛逆。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen, Governor-general Zhang Jingxin memorialized that the tribal officials who had killed officeholders Huang Rizhang and Huang Dezhi of Siming Prefecture had incited the crowd to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongzhen Governor-general Zhang Jingxin reported that tribal officials including Huang Rizhang and Huang Dezhi of Siming Prefecture had killed officeholders and incited the people to rebel.

sentences.zh: 帝令速擒首惡以靖地方。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the ringleaders swiftly captured to settle the region.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the ringleaders swiftly captured to restore order to the region.

sentences.zh: 論者以黃矰神奸，身逭大盩，世濟其兇，傳及四世，猶並思明州而有之，王綱隳矣。

translations.literal: Commentators held that Huang Zeng was diabolically cunning, personally escaped great punishment, and his descendants perpetuated his violence through four generations, yet still held Siming Prefecture as well—the royal norms were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that Huang Zeng was diabolically cunning, personally escaped severe punishment, and his descendants perpetuated his violence through four generations, yet still held Siming Prefecture as well—the royal norms had collapsed.

sentences.zh: 然骨肉相屠，至是四見，蓋天道雲。

translations.literal: Yet fratricide had by now been seen four times—surely this was heaven's way.
translations.idiomatic: Yet fratricide had by now been seen four times in this clan—surely this was heaven's judgment manifest.

sentences.zh: 思明州，東抵思明府，西抵交阯界，南抵西平州，北抵龍英州。

translations.literal: Siming Prefecture bordered Siming Fu on the east, the Jiaozhi boundary on the west, Xiping Prefecture on the south, and Longying Prefecture on the north.
translations.idiomatic: Siming Prefecture bordered Siming Fu on the east, the Jiaozhi boundary on the west, Xiping Prefecture on the south, and Longying Prefecture on the north.

sentences.zh: 土官黃姓，與思明府同族。

translations.literal: The tribal officials were of the Huang clan, related to the Huang family of Siming Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal officials were of the Huang clan, related to the Huang family of Siming Fu.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，黃君壽歸附，授世襲知州，屬思明府，後為黃矰所並。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu Huang Junshou submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefect under Siming Fu; later he was absorbed by Huang Zeng.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu Huang Junshou submitted and was granted the hereditary post of prefect under Siming Fu; later he was absorbed by Huang Zeng.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十六年，黃拱聖之亂，改屬太平。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Wanli, during Huang Gongsheng's rebellion, it was transferred to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Wanli, during Huang Gongsheng's rebellion, it was transferred to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 上石西州，宋屬永平寨，元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Shangshi West Prefecture under Song belonged to Yongping Stockade; under Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shangshi West Prefecture belonged to Yongping Stockade under the Song and to Siming Circuit under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明初屬思明府，至萬歷三十八年改屬太平府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming it belonged to Siming Fu; in the thirty-eighth year of Wanli it was transferred to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Ming it belonged to Siming Fu; in the thirty-eighth year of Wanli it was transferred to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 州更土官趙氏、何氏、黃氏凡三姓，皆絕，始改流官。

translations.literal: The prefecture had three successive tribal officials of the Zhao, He, and Huang clans; when all lines died out, it was changed to regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had three successive tribal official clans—Zhao, He, and Huang; when all lines died out, the post was converted to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 下石西州，宋分石西州置，元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Xiashi West Prefecture was established when Song divided Shixi Prefecture; under Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xiashi West Prefecture was established when the Song divided Shixi Prefecture; under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，土官閉賢歸附。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, the tribal official Bi Xian submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongwu the tribal official Bi Xian submitted.

sentences.zh: 授世襲知州，設流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: He was granted hereditary prefect; a regular official clerk was established to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the hereditary post of prefect, with a regular official clerk appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 忠州，宋置，隸邕州。

translations.literal: Zhongzhou was established in Song and subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzhou was established under the Song and subordinate to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官黃威慶率子中謹歸附，授威慶江州知州，中謹忠州知州，皆世襲，設流官同知吏目佐之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the tribal official Huang Weiqing led his son Zhongjin to submit; Weiqing was granted Jiangzhou prefect, Zhongjin Zhongzhou prefect, both hereditary; regular vice prefects and clerks were established to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the tribal official Huang Weiqing led his son Zhongjin to submit; Weiqing was granted Jiangzhou prefect and Zhongjin Zhongzhou prefect, both hereditary, with regular vice prefects and clerks appointed to assist them.

sentences.zh: 其鄰地有四峒者，界於南寧、思明、忠江之間，思明、忠州屢肆侵奪。

translations.literal: In the neighboring area was a place called the Four Caves, bounded by Nanning, Siming, and Zhongjiang; Siming and Zhongzhou repeatedly encroached and seized it.
translations.idiomatic: In the neighboring area was a region called the Four Caves, bounded by Nanning, Siming, and Zhongjiang; Siming and Zhongzhou repeatedly encroached upon and seized its territory.

sentences.zh: 副使翁萬達議改峒名四都，隸之南寧，地方稍定。

translations.literal: Vice commissioner Weng Wanda proposed changing the cave name to the Four Du and subordinating it to Nanning; the region was somewhat settled.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Weng Wanda proposed renaming the Four Caves the Four Du and subordinating the region to Nanning; the area was somewhat settled.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年冬，思明府土官黃承祖奏取四都地，忠州土官黃賢相爭之，遂擅立總管諸名目，分兵數千戍守，因縱令剽掠，為禍甚烈。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Longqing, the Siming Prefecture tribal official Huang Chengzu memorialized to take the Four Du territory; the Zhongzhou tribal official Huang Xianxiang contested it; he then presumptuously established titles such as general overseer, divided several thousand troops to garrison it, and thereby allowed plunder—the harm was very severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year of Longqing the Siming tribal official Huang Chengzu memorialized to seize the Four Du territory; the Zhongzhou tribal official Huang Xianxiang contested the claim; Xianxiang then presumptuously established titles such as general overseer, garrisoned several thousand troops, and allowed plunder—the damage was severe.

sentences.zh: 僉事譚惟鼎調永康典史李材以計擒賢相，斃之於獄。

translations.literal: Commissioner Tan Weiding dispatched Yongkang recorder Li Cai with a stratagem to capture Xianxiang and had him beaten to death in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Tan Weiding dispatched Yongkang Recorder Li Cai with a stratagem to capture Huang Xianxiang, who was beaten to death in prison.

sentences.zh: 議改流官，不果，遂改隸州於南寧，仍以州印予賢相子有瀚，俾襲職。

translations.literal: A proposal to change to regular officials did not succeed; the prefecture was then transferred to Nanning's jurisdiction, and the prefectural seal was still given to Xianxiang's son Youhan to succeed to the office.
translations.idiomatic: A proposal to convert the post to regular administration did not succeed; the prefecture was transferred to Nanning's jurisdiction, and the prefectural seal was given to Huang Xianxiang's son Youhan to succeed to the office.

sentences.zh: 憑祥，宋為憑祥洞，屬永平寨，元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Pingxiang in Song was Pingxiang Cave, subordinate to Yongping Stockade; under Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Pingxiang was Pingxiang Cave under the Song, subordinate to Yongping Stockade; under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十八年，土蠻李升歸附。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Hongwu, the tribal leader Li Sheng submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Hongwu the tribal leader Li Sheng submitted.

sentences.zh: 置憑祥鎮，授升巡檢，屬思明府。

translations.literal: Pingxiang garrison was established; Sheng was granted inspector, subordinate to Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingxiang garrison was established; Li Sheng was granted the post of inspector under Siming Fu.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年置縣，以升為知縣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle a county was established; Sheng was made county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle a county was established and Li Sheng was appointed county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 成化八年升為州，以升孫廣寧為知州，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chenghua it was promoted to prefecture; Sheng's grandson Guangning was made prefect, directly subordinate to the provincial administration commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Chenghua it was promoted to prefectural status; Li Sheng's grandson Guangning was appointed prefect, directly subordinate to the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 廣寧有十子，廣寧死，諸子爭立不決，凡三四年，乃以孫珠襲知州職。

translations.literal: Guangning had ten sons; when Guangning died, the sons fought over succession without resolution for three or four years; finally grandson Zhu succeeded to the prefect's office.
translations.idiomatic: Guangning had ten sons; when he died his sons fought over succession for three or four years without resolution; finally his grandson Zhu succeeded to the prefect's office.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十年，珠死，族弟珍、玨爭立，珍挈印走況村，玨攝州事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Jiajing, Zhu died; clansmen Zhen and Jue fought over succession; Zhen took the seal and fled to Kuangcun, while Jue administered prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Jiajing Zhu died; clansmen Zhen and Jue fought over succession; Zhen took the seal and fled to Kuangcun while Jue administered prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 十四年，州目李清、趙琪等謀納珍，許思明府黃朝以州屬之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, prefectural clerks Li Qing, Zhao Qi, and others plotted to bring in Zhen, promising Siming Prefecture's Huang Chao that the prefecture would be subordinated to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year prefectural clerks Li Qing, Zhao Qi, and others plotted to install Zhen, promising Siming's Huang Chao that the prefecture would be subordinated to him.

sentences.zh: 朝遂以兵納珍於憑祥，玨奔罄柳。

translations.literal: Chao then brought Zhen into Pingxiang by force; Jue fled to Qingliu.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao then brought Zhen into Pingxiang by force; Jue fled to Qingliu.

sentences.zh: 既珍悔屬思明，與朝隙，朝乃以外婦所生子時芳，詭雲廣寧孫，以兵千人納之。

translations.literal: Afterward Zhen regretted subordination to Siming and fell out with Chao; Chao then took Shifang, son by an outside wife, falsely claiming he was Guangning's grandson, and brought him in with a thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen soon regretted subordination to Siming and fell out with Huang Chao; Chao then installed Shifang, a son by an outside wife whom he falsely claimed was Guangning's grandson, bringing him in with a thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 時珍淫縱，為部民所怨，於是廣寧季子寰以尊屬謀廢立。

translations.literal: Shizhen was licentious and unrestrained, hated by the people of the prefecture; thereupon Guangning's youngest son Huan, as senior clansman, plotted deposition and installation.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen was licentious and unrestrained and hated by the people of the prefecture; Guangning's youngest son Huan, as senior clansman, then plotted to depose and replace him.

sentences.zh: 十七年，寰遂殺珍而附於安南，莫登庸藉為向導。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Huan then killed Zhen and submitted to Annam; Mac Dang Dung used him as a guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Huan killed Zhen and submitted to Annam; Mac Dang Dung used him as a guide.

sentences.zh: 總督蔡經屬副使翁萬達擒之，論死。

translations.literal: Governor-general Cai Jing entrusted Vice Commissioner Weng Wanda to capture him; he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Cai Jing entrusted Vice Commissioner Weng Wanda to capture him; he was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 於是玨與時芳復爭立，時芳倚思明勢，州民皆右之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Jue and Shifang again fought over succession; Shifang relied on Siming's power, and the people of the prefecture all favored him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Jue and Shifang again fought over succession; Shifang relied on Siming's power, and the people of the prefecture all favored him.

sentences.zh: 萬達黜玨而論時芳死，更立李佛嗣珍為知州，憑祥遂定。

translations.literal: Wanda dismissed Jue and sentenced Shifang to death; he installed Li Fo, Zhen's heir, as prefect, and Pingxiang was thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Wanda dismissed Jue and sentenced Shifang to death; he installed Li Fo, Zhen's heir, as prefect, and Pingxiang was thereby settled.

sentences.zh: 思恩，漢屬交阯。

translations.literal: Si'en in Han times belonged to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Si'en had belonged to Jiaozhi under the Han.

sentences.zh: 唐為思恩州，屬邕，乃澄州止戈縣地。

translations.literal: Under Tang it was Si'en Prefecture, subordinate to Yong; it was the territory of Zhige County in Cheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Si'en Prefecture, subordinate to Yongzhou; it was the territory of Zhige County in Cheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋開寶間，廢澄州，以止戈、賀水、無虞三縣省入上林。

translations.literal: During the Kaibao era of Song, Cheng Prefecture was abolished; the three counties of Zhige, Heshui, and Wuyu were merged into Shanglin.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaibao era of the Song, Cheng Prefecture was abolished and the three counties of Zhige, Heshui, and Wuyu were merged into Shanglin.

sentences.zh: 治平間，以上林之止戈入武緣，隸邕。

translations.literal: During the Zhiping era, Zhige of Shanglin was transferred to Wuyuan and subordinated to Yong.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiping era, Zhige of Shanglin was transferred to Wuyuan and subordinated to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元屬田州路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 歷代羈縻而已。

translations.literal: Through successive dynasties it was merely jimi territory.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive dynasties it remained merely jimi territory.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二十二年，田州府知府岑堅遣其子思恩州知州永昌貢方物。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Hongwu of Ming, Tianzhou Prefecture Prefect Cen Jian dispatched his son, Si'en Prefecture Magistrate Yongchang, to present local products in tribute.
