translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Hongwu, Tianzhou Prefect Cen Jian dispatched his son Yongchang, magistrate of Si'en Prefecture, to present local products in tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，歸德州土官黃碧言，思恩州知州岑永昌既匿五縣民，不供賦稅，仍用故元印章。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Guide Prefecture tribal official Huang Bi said that Si'en Prefecture Magistrate Cen Yongchang had hidden the people of five counties, failed to supply taxes and levies, and still used the former Yuan seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the Guide Prefecture tribal official Huang Bi reported that Si'en Magistrate Cen Yongchang had hidden the people of five counties, failed to supply taxes and levies, and still used the former Yuan seal.

sentences.zh: 帝以不奉朝命，命左都督楊文相機討之，既以荒遠不問。

translations.literal: The emperor, because he did not obey court orders, ordered Left Cavalry General Yang Wen to suppress him when circumstances permitted; afterward, because the region was remote and wild, no further action was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had defied court orders, the emperor ordered Left Cavalry General Yang Wen to suppress him when circumstances permitted; afterward, because the region was remote and wild, no further action was taken.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，改屬布政司，時居民僅八百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle, it was transferred to the provincial administration commission; at that time the residents numbered only eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongle reign it was transferred to the provincial administration commission; at that time the population numbered only eight hundred households.

sentences.zh: 永昌死，子瑛襲。

translations.literal: Yongchang died; his son Ying succeeded to the office.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongchang died, his son Ying inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年，瑛遣弟敬貢馬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande, Ying sent his younger brother Jing to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In 1427, Ying dispatched his younger brother Jing to court with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 正統三年進瑛職為知府，仍掌州事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong, Ying's rank was advanced to prefectural commissioner, and he still managed prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1438, Ying was promoted to prefectural commissioner while continuing to govern the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瑛有謀略，善治兵，從征蠻寇，屢有功，故有是命。

translations.literal: Ying had strategizing ability, was skilled at managing troops, followed on campaigns against Man bandits, and repeatedly achieved merit; therefore he received this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was resourceful and skilled in military affairs; in campaigns against tribal rebels he won repeated distinction, which earned him the promotion.

sentences.zh: 因與知府岑紹交惡，各具奏，下總兵官及三司議。

translations.literal: Because he and Prefectural Commissioner Cen Shao became mutually hostile, each submitted a memorial; the matter was referred to the regional commander and the three offices for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: He fell out with Prefectural Commissioner Cen Shao, and both filed accusations; the case was sent down to the regional commander and the provincial triumvirate for review.

sentences.zh: 於是安遠侯柳溥等請升思恩為府，俾瑛、紹各守疆土，以杜侵爭，從之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Marquis of An'yuan Liu Pu and others requested that Si'en be elevated to a prefecture, so that Ying and Shao might each guard their own territory and thereby stop encroachment and conflict; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of An'yuan Liu Pu and others then petitioned to raise Si'en to prefectural status, assigning Ying and Shao separate domains to forestall border disputes. The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 六年，瑛受屬挾詐事覺，帝以土蠻宥不問，令法司移文戒之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Ying's involvement in a subordinate's extortion by deceit was discovered; the emperor, because he was a native chieftain, pardoned and did not inquire, and ordered the judicial authorities to send an official letter admonishing him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Ying was implicated when a subordinate's scheme of extortion came to light. The emperor, treating him leniently as a tribal headman, waived prosecution and had the judiciary issue a written warning.

sentences.zh: 瑛以府治僻隘，橋利堡正當瑤寇出沒之所，且有城垣公廨，乞徙置，許之。

translations.literal: Ying, because the prefectural seat was remote and narrow, and Qiaoli Fort lay right where Yao bandits came and went, and moreover had city walls and government offices, requested that the seat be moved there; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ying argued that the prefectural seat was too remote and poorly situated, while Qiaoli Fort—already fortified with walls and yamen offices—stood on a route frequented by Yao raiders and would make a better capital. His request to relocate was approved.

sentences.zh: 以思恩府為思恩軍民府。

translations.literal: Si'en Prefecture was redesignated Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Si'en Prefecture was renamed the Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二年設儒學，置教授一員，訓導四員，俱從瑛請也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year a Confucian school was established, with one professor and four instructors appointed—all at Ying's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year a state school was founded with one professor and four instructors, all as Ying had petitioned.

sentences.zh: 景泰四年，總兵官陳旺奏：「思恩土兵調赴桂林哨守者，離本府遼遠，不便耕種，稅糧宜暫免。」

translations.literal: In 1453, Regional Commander Chen Wang memorialized, "The Si'en native troops posted to Guilin sentry duty are too far from their home prefecture to tend their fields conveniently, and their grain levies should be temporarily exempted."
translations.idiomatic: In 1453, Regional Commander Chen Wang memorialized, "The Si'en native troops posted to Guilin sentry duty are too far from their home prefecture to tend their fields conveniently, and their grain levies should be temporarily exempted."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 六月，以瑛親率本部狼兵韋陳威等赴城操練，協助軍威，敕授奉議大夫，賜彩緞，韋陳威等俱給冠帶。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, because Ying personally led his own Lang troops including Wei Chenwei to the city for drill exercises to bolster military prestige, he was decreed Grand Master of Discussion, granted colored silks, and Wei Chenwei and the others were all given official caps and belts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Ying was enfeoffed as Grand Master of Discussion and rewarded with brocade for personally leading his Lang auxiliaries, including Wei Chenwei, into the city for training maneuvers that strengthened the garrison. Wei Chenwei and his fellows received official headgear and sashes.

sentences.zh: 五年從瑛請建廟學，造祭祀樂器。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, at Ying's request, a temple school was built and sacrificial musical instruments were made.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later, again following Ying's petition, a shrine school was established and ritual instruments were cast.

sentences.zh: 又以瑛征剿瑤寇功，免土軍今年應輸田糧之半，進瑛從二品散官。

translations.literal: Also, because of Ying's merit in campaigning against and suppressing Yao bandits, half of the native troops' grain levies due this year were remitted, and Ying was advanced to a second-rank honorary office.
translations.idiomatic: In recognition of Ying's victories against Yao rebels, the native troops' grain quota for the year was cut by half, and Ying was promoted to a second-rank ceremonial rank.

sentences.zh: 瑛屢領兵隨征，以子鑌代為知府。

translations.literal: Ying repeatedly led troops on campaign; his son Bin served in his stead as prefectural commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: As Ying was often away campaigning, his son Bin acted as prefectural commissioner in his place.

sentences.zh: 鑌招集無賴，肆為不法。

translations.literal: Bin gathered idle scoundrels and wantonly committed unlawful acts.
translations.idiomatic: Bin recruited ruffians and ran wild with abuses of power.

sentences.zh: 瑛舉發其事，請於總兵，回府治之。

translations.literal: Ying exposed the matter, requested permission from the regional commander, and returned to the prefecture to deal with it.
translations.idiomatic: Ying reported the abuses, obtained the regional commander's leave, and returned home to take charge.

sentences.zh: 鑌聞其父將至，自縊死。

translations.literal: When Bin heard that his father was coming, he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that his father was on his way, Bin took his own life by hanging.

sentences.zh: 事聞，嘉其能割愛效忠，降敕慰諭。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the court praised his ability to renounce personal affection and serve with loyalty, and issued an edict of consolation and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor commended Ying for placing duty above family and sent an edict of consolation.

sentences.zh: 又以柳溥奏，免思恩調用土軍千五百人、秋糧二千三百余石。

translations.literal: Also, following Liu Pu's memorial, remission was granted for Si'en's requisition of fifteen hundred native troops and more than twenty-three hundred shi of autumn grain.
translations.idiomatic: On Liu Pu's recommendation, the requisition of fifteen hundred Si'en native troops and over twenty-three hundred shi of autumn grain was waived.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，戶部奏：「思恩存留廣西操練軍一千五百人，有誤種田納糧。

translations.literal: In 1457, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized, "The fifteen hundred Si'en troops retained in Guangxi for drilling interfere with farming and grain-tax payment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1457, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized, "The fifteen hundred Si'en troops retained in Guangxi for drilling interfere with farming and grain-tax payment.

sentences.zh: 乞分為三班，留五百人操練，免其糧七百七十余石。

translations.literal: We beg that they be divided into three rotations, with five hundred men retained for drilling and their grain of over seven hundred seventy shi exempted.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that they be divided into three rotations, with five hundred men retained for drilling and their grain of over seven hundred seventy shi exempted.

sentences.zh: 放回千人耕種，征其糧千五百四十余石，俟寧靖日放回全征。」

translations.literal: The remaining thousand should be released to return to farming, with their grain levy set at more than fifteen hundred forty shi; when peace has been restored, release them all and levy the full amount."
translations.idiomatic: The remaining thousand should be released to return to farming, with their grain levy set at more than fifteen hundred forty shi; when peace has been restored, release them all and levy the full amount."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三年，鎮守中官朱祥奏請量遷瑛都司軍職。

translations.literal: In the third year, the resident eunuch Zhu Xiang memorialized requesting that Ying be appropriately transferred to a guard commission military post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Resident Eunuch Zhu Xiang petitioned to have Ying transferred to an appropriate military post in the guard system.

sentences.zh: 帝以瑛歷練老成，累有軍功，改授都指揮同知，仍聽總兵官鎮守調用，以其子鐩為知府。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Ying experienced and seasoned with repeated military achievements, reassigned him as vice commander of the guard, still subject to deployment by the regional commander, and appointed his son Sui as prefectural commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, noting Ying's long experience and repeated battlefield honors, reassigned him as vice commander of the guard while keeping him under the regional commander's orders, and named his son Sui prefectural commissioner.

sentences.zh: 成化元年遣兵科給事中王秉彜賫敕獎諭瑛父子，並賜銀幣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua, Supervising Secretary Wang Bingyi of the Ministry of War was dispatched bearing an edict to commend and instruct Ying and his son, and silver and silks were bestowed on them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1465, Supervising Secretary Wang Bingyi of the Ministry of War was sent with an imperial edict commending Ying and his son, along with gifts of silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 二年命給瑛父母妻誥命，從總兵趙輔請也。

translations.literal: In the second year, patent letters of appointment were granted to Ying's parents and wife, at Regional Commander Zhao Fu's request.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, patent letters of appointment were issued to Ying's parents and wife, at the request of Regional Commander Zhao Fu.

sentences.zh: 十四年，瑛卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Ying died.

sentences.zh: 瑛自襲父職，頻年領兵於外，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: From inheriting his father's post, Ying for years led troops abroad and achieved many kills and captures.
translations.idiomatic: From the time he succeeded his father, Ying spent years campaigning abroad and won many victories in battle.

sentences.zh: 歷升知府、參政、都指揮使。

translations.literal: He rose through the ranks to prefectural commissioner, vice commissioner, and guard commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to prefectural commissioner, vice commissioner, and guard commander.

sentences.zh: 年且八十，尚在軍中。

translations.literal: Though nearly eighty, he was still in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Though nearly eighty, he was still serving in the field.

sentences.zh: 既卒，鐩以誥請，帝念其勞，特賜之。

translations.literal: After his death, Sui petitioned for patent honors; the emperor, mindful of his service, specially granted them.
translations.idiomatic: After his death, Sui petitioned for patent honors for his father; the emperor, remembering his long service, granted them as a special favor.

sentences.zh: 十六年，田州府土目黃明作亂，知府岑溥避入思恩，鐩會鎮守等官討平之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Tianzhou Prefecture native subofficial Huang Ming rebelled; Prefectural Commissioner Cen Pu fled into Si'en, and Sui joined the resident officials in suppressing the uprising.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Huang Ming, a Tianzhou native subofficial, rebelled. Prefectural Commissioner Cen Pu took refuge in Si'en, and Sui joined the resident officials in putting down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 巡撫朱英請獎鐩功。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhu Ying requested rewards for Sui's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhu Ying petitioned for rewards in recognition of Sui's service.

sentences.zh: 鐩死，子浚襲。

translations.literal: When Sui died, his son Jun succeeded to the office.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui died, his son Jun inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年，田州土官岑溥為子猇所殺，猇亦死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Hongzhi, Tianzhou native official Cen Pu was killed by his son Xiao, who also died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1499, Tianzhou native official Cen Pu was killed by his son Xiao, who died shortly afterward as well.

sentences.zh: 次子猛幼，頭目黃驥、李蠻構難，督府命浚調眾護猛。

translations.literal: The second son Meng was young; subofficials Huang Ji and Li Man stirred up trouble; the governor's office ordered Jun to mobilize troops to protect Meng.
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Meng, was still a child. Subofficials Huang Ji and Li Man fomented discord, and the governor's office ordered Jun to raise troops to protect him.

sentences.zh: 驥厚賂浚，並獻其女，且約分地與浚。

translations.literal: Ji bribed Jun lavishly, offered him his daughter in marriage, and moreover agreed to divide territory with Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Ji lavished bribes on Jun, offered him his daughter in marriage, and promised to share territory with him.

sentences.zh: 浚以兵屬驥，送猛至田州。

translations.literal: Jun placed troops under Ji's command and escorted Meng to Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jun put his troops under Ji's command and escorted Meng to Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 不得入，猛遂久留浚所。

translations.literal: They could not enter; Meng then remained long at Jun's seat.
translations.idiomatic: They could not gain entry, and Meng ended up staying with Jun for a long time.

sentences.zh: 及總鎮諸官攝浚，乃出猛襲知府。

translations.literal: When the overall commander and other officials pressured Jun, he then sent Meng out to succeed as prefectural commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Only when the overall commander and other officials pressed Jun did he release Meng to succeed as prefectural commissioner.

sentences.zh: 浚從索故分地，不得，怒，約泗城、東蘭二州攻劫田州，殺掠萬計，城郭為墟。

translations.literal: Jun then demanded the territory previously allotted to him but did not obtain it; enraged, he allied with the two prefectures of Sicheng and Donglan to attack and plunder Tianzhou; killings and lootings numbered in the tens of thousands, and towns and walls were reduced to ruins.
translations.idiomatic: Jun then demanded the territory he had been promised but was refused. Enraged, he joined forces with Sicheng and Donglan to raid Tianzhou; tens of thousands were killed or plundered, and the towns were left in ruins.

sentences.zh: 浚兵二萬據舊田州，劫龍州印，納故知府趙源妻岑氏。

translations.literal: Jun's twenty thousand troops held old Tianzhou, seized the Longzhou seal, and took in Lady Cen, wife of the former prefectural commissioner Zhao Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's force of twenty thousand occupied old Tianzhou, seized the Longzhou seal, and took in Lady Cen, widow of the former prefect Zhao Yuan.

sentences.zh: 及總兵官詣田州勘治，黃驥懼，匿浚所。

translations.literal: When the regional commander went to Tianzhou to investigate and settle matters, Huang Ji feared punishment and hid at Jun's seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the regional commander came to Tianzhou to investigate, Huang Ji, fearing retribution, took refuge with Jun.

sentences.zh: 先是，浚築石城於丹良莊，屯兵千余人，截江道以括商利，官命毀之，不聽。

translations.literal: Earlier, Jun had built a stone fort at Danliang Village, garrisoned more than a thousand troops, and blocked the river route to extort merchant profits; when officials ordered it destroyed, he refused.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Jun had built a stone fort at Danliang Village, stationed over a thousand men there, and blocked the river trade route to squeeze merchant profits. When officials ordered the fort dismantled, he refused.

sentences.zh: 會官軍自田州還，乘便毀其城。

translations.literal: When government troops were returning from Tianzhou, they took the opportunity to destroy the fort.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops returning from Tianzhou seized the chance to tear down the fort.

sentences.zh: 浚兵來拒，殺官軍二十余人。

translations.literal: Jun's troops came to resist and killed more than twenty government soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's men came out to resist and killed more than twenty government soldiers.

sentences.zh: 官軍敗之，俘其目兵九人。

translations.literal: Government troops defeated them and captured nine of their tribal soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops routed them and took nine tribal soldiers prisoner.

sentences.zh: 總鎮及巡按等官請治浚罪，而參政武清納浚賂，曲護之。

translations.literal: The overall commander and censor-in-chief and other officials requested that Jun be punished, but Vice Commissioner Wu Qing accepted Jun's bribes and bent the law to protect him.
translations.idiomatic: The overall commander, touring censor, and other officials called for Jun's prosecution, but Vice Commissioner Wu Qing took his bribes and shielded him.

sentences.zh: 浚從弟業少從中官京師，仕為大理寺副三司。

translations.literal: Jun's younger cousin Ye had followed a eunuch to the capital in his youth and served as deputy of the Court of Judicial Review in the capital bureaucracy.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's younger cousin Ye had gone to the capital as a youth in the retinue of a eunuch and held office as deputy of the Court of Judicial Review in the metropolitan administration.

sentences.zh: 總鎮請敕業往諭，兵部以浚稔惡，非業所能諭責，宜敕鎮巡召浚至軍門，諭以朝廷威德，罪其首惡，反侵地，納所劫印，並官私財物，乃可赦。

translations.literal: The overall commander requested an edict dispatching Ye to admonish Jun; the Ministry of War held that Jun's wickedness was deeply rooted and Ye could not admonish or hold him accountable; the regional commander and grand coordinator should summon Jun to headquarters, instruct him in the court's authority and virtue, punish the chief culprits, return seized territory, surrender the stolen seal along with public and private goods—only then could pardon be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The overall commander asked that Ye be sent with an edict to reason with Jun, but the Ministry of War argued that Jun's crimes were too entrenched for Ye to rebuke him into submission. Jun should instead be summoned to headquarters, instructed in the court's authority and mercy, required to punish the ringleaders, return seized lands, surrender the stolen seal and all looted property—only then might he be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 總督鄧廷瓚奏：「浚屢撫不服，請調官軍土兵分哨逐捕按問。

translations.literal: Governor-General Deng Tingzan memorialized, "Jun has repeatedly refused pacification; I request that regular troops and native soldiers be deployed in separate columns to pursue, capture, investigate, and interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Deng Tingzan memorialized, "Jun has repeatedly refused pacification; I request that regular troops and native soldiers be deployed in separate columns to pursue, capture, investigate, and interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 如集兵拒敵，相機剿殺，並將田州土官岑猛一並區處，以靖邊疆。」

translations.literal: If he gathers troops to resist, destroy him as opportunity allows, and deal at the same time with Cen Meng, the native official of Tianzhou, so that the frontier may be settled."
translations.idiomatic: If he gathers troops to resist, destroy him as opportunity allows, and deal at the same time with Cen Meng, the native official of Tianzhou, so that the frontier may be settled."

sentences.zh: 十六年，總督潘蕃奏：「浚僭叛，當用兵誅剿。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Governor-General Pan Fan memorialized, "Jun has usurped authority and rebelled; troops should be used to punish and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Governor-General Pan Fan memorialized, "Jun has usurped authority and rebelled; troops should be used to punish and suppress him.

sentences.zh: 今浚從弟歲業以山東布政司參議在內閣制敕房辦事，禁密之地，恐有泄漏。」

translations.literal: Now Jun's younger cousin Suiye is serving as a Shandong provincial administration vice commissioner in the Secretariat Edict Drafting Office, a place of strict secrecy, and I fear there may be leaks."
translations.idiomatic: Now Jun's younger cousin Suiye is serving as a Shandong provincial administration vice commissioner in the Secretariat Edict Drafting Office, a place of strict secrecy, and I fear there may be leaks."

sentences.zh: 吏部擬改調，而業亦奏乞養去。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel proposed transferring him, and Ye also memorialized requesting leave to care for his parents and depart.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel proposed transferring him, and Ye himself petitioned to resign and return home to care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 十七年，浚掠上林、武緣等縣，死者不可勝計。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Jun raided Shanglin, Wuyuan, and other counties; the dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Jun raided Shanglin, Wuyuan, and other counties, leaving a death toll too vast to count.

sentences.zh: 又攻破田州，猛僅以身免，掠其家屬五十人。

translations.literal: He again broke into Tianzhou; Meng barely escaped with his life, and fifty of his family members were seized.
translations.idiomatic: He again stormed Tianzhou; Meng escaped only with his life, while fifty members of his household were taken captive.

sentences.zh: 總鎮以聞，兵部請調三廣兵剿之。

translations.literal: The overall commander reported the matter; the Ministry of War requested mobilizing troops from the three Guang regions to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: The overall commander reported the raids, and the Ministry of War called for troops from the three Guang regions to suppress Jun.

sentences.zh: 十八年，總督潘蕃、太監韋經、總兵毛銳調集兩廣、湖廣官軍土兵十萬八千余人，分六哨。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Governor-General Pan Fan, Eunuch Wei Jing, and Regional Commander Mao Rui mustered more than 108,000 regular and native troops from the Two Guangs and Huguang, divided into six columns.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Governor-General Pan Fan, Eunuch Wei Jing, and Regional Commander Mao Rui assembled more than 108,000 regular and native troops from the Two Guangs and Huguang, organized into six columns.

sentences.zh: 副總兵毛倫、右參政王璘由慶遠，右參將王震、左參將王臣及湖廣都指揮官纓由柳州，左參將楊玉、僉事丁隆由武緣，都指揮金堂、副使姜綰由上林，都指揮何清、參議詹璽由丹良，都指揮李銘、泗城州土舍岑接由工堯，各取道共抵巢寨。

translations.literal: Vice Regional Commander Mao Lun and Right Vice Commissioner Wang Lin came by Qingyuan; Right Assistant Regional Commander Wang Zhen, Left Assistant Regional Commander Wang Chen, and Huguang Guard Commander Guan Ying by Liuzhou; Left Assistant Regional Commander Yang Yu and Commissioner Ding Long by Wuyuan; Guard Commander Jin Tang and Vice Commissioner Jiang Kuo by Shanglin; Guard Commander He Qing and Commissioner Zhan Xi by Danliang; Guard Commander Li Ming and Sicheng native probationary official Cen Jie by Gongyao—each taking his route, they together reached the rebel stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Regional Commander Mao Lun and Right Vice Commissioner Wang Lin advanced from Qingyuan; Right Assistant Regional Commander Wang Zhen, Left Assistant Regional Commander Wang Chen, and Huguang Guard Commander Guan Ying from Liuzhou; Left Assistant Regional Commander Yang Yu and Commissioner Ding Long from Wuyuan; Guard Commander Jin Tang and Vice Commissioner Jiang Kuo from Shanglin; Guard Commander He Qing and Commissioner Zhan Xi from Danliang; and Guard Commander Li Ming with Sicheng native officer Cen Jie from Gongyao—all converging by separate routes on the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 賊分兵阻險拒敵，官軍奮勇直前，援崖而進。

translations.literal: The rebels divided their forces to block strategic points and resist; government troops pressed forward bravely, scaling cliffs to advance.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels split their forces to hold the passes, but government troops pressed forward with fierce courage, climbing cliffs to reach them.

sentences.zh: 浚勢蹙，遁入舊城，諸軍圍攻之。

translations.literal: Jun's situation grew desperate; he fled into the old city, and the armies besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's position collapsed; he fled into the old city, and the allied armies laid siege.

sentences.zh: 浚死，城中人獻其首，思恩遂平。

translations.literal: Jun died; people in the city presented his head, and Si'en was thus pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was killed, and the people of the city presented his head; Si'en was thereby pacified.

sentences.zh: 前後斬捕四千七百九十級，俘男女八百人，得思恩府印二，向武州印一。

translations.literal: Before and after, four thousand seven hundred ninety heads or captures were taken, eight hundred men and women were captured, two Si'en prefectural seals and one Xiangwu prefectural seal were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In all, 4,790 enemy heads or captives were taken, eight hundred men and women were seized, and two Si'en prefectural seals and one Xiangwu prefectural seal were recovered.

sentences.zh: 自進兵及班師僅逾月。

translations.literal: From advancing to withdrawing the troops, barely more than a month passed.
translations.idiomatic: From the opening of the campaign to the withdrawal of the troops, barely a month had passed.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝以蕃等有功，璽書勞之。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, the emperor, because Fan and the others had merit, sent an imperial letter of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When news of victory arrived, the emperor sent an imperial letter commending Fan and the others for their service.

sentences.zh: 兵部議浚既伏誅，不宜再錄其後，改設流官，擇其可者。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that since Jun had already been executed, his descendants should not be recorded again; a regular official should be installed instead, choosing one who was suitable.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War argued that since Jun had already been put to death, his line should not be restored; a regular official should be appointed instead, chosen from among those fit for the post.

sentences.zh: 以雲南知府張鳳升廣西右參政，掌思恩府事，賜敕。

translations.literal: Yunnan Prefect Zhang Feng was promoted to Guangxi Right Vice Commissioner to manage Si'en Prefecture affairs, and was granted an edict.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Feng, prefect of Yunnan, was promoted to Guangxi Right Vice Commissioner to govern Si'en Prefecture and was granted an imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 正德七年增設鳳化縣治。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengde, the Fenghua county seat was added.
translations.idiomatic: In 1512, a county seat was established at Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 時初設流官，諸蠻未服，相繼作亂。

translations.literal: At that time, with the new regular officials just installed, the various tribes had not submitted and rose in rebellion one after another.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, with regular officials newly installed, the tribal peoples had not yet submitted and rebelled in succession.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年，都御史盛應期遣官軍平之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiajing, Censor-in-Chief Sheng Yingqi dispatched government troops to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1525, Censor-in-Chief Sheng Yingqi sent government troops to suppress the uprisings.

sentences.zh: 六年，土目王受與田州盧蘇謀煽亂，勢復熾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, native subofficial Wang Shou conspired with Tianzhou's Lu Su to stir rebellion, and the turmoil flared anew.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, native subofficial Wang Shou conspired with Lu Su of Tianzhou to foment rebellion, and the unrest flared up again.

sentences.zh: 新建伯王守仁受命至，一意招撫，而檄受等破八寨賊，因列思恩地為九土巡檢司，管以頭目，授王受白山司巡檢，得比於世官。

translations.literal: Marquis of Xinjian Wang Shouren, upon receiving his commission, devoted himself entirely to pacification by conciliation; he also ordered Wang Shou and the others to break the bandits of the Eight Stockades, and accordingly divided Si'en territory into nine native subprefectures, administered by headmen; Wang Shou was appointed subprefect of Baishan, entitled to rank as a hereditary official.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Xinjian Wang Shouren arrived on commission and pursued conciliation above all else, while dispatching Wang Shou and others to crush the bandits of the Eight Stockades. He then divided Si'en into nine native subprefectures under tribal headmen, appointing Wang Shou subprefect of Baishan with hereditary standing.

sentences.zh: 又以思恩舊治瘴霧昏塞，宜更之爽塏。

translations.literal: He also held that Si'en's old seat was malarial, fog-shrouded, and oppressive, and ought to be moved to clearer, open ground.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that Si'en's old seat was malarial and hemmed in by fog, and should be moved to healthier, more open ground.

sentences.zh: 於是擇地荒田建新郡，割武緣止戈二里益之；

translations.literal: Thus he chose wasteland to build a new prefectural seat, annexing two li from Wuyuan's Zhige district to enlarge it;
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly he chose wasteland for a new prefectural seat and annexed two li from Wuyuan's Zhige district to enlarge it;

sentences.zh: 又議割上林三里，而移鳳化縣治於其處。

translations.literal: and further proposed annexing three li from Shanglin and moving the Fenghua county seat there.
translations.idiomatic: he further proposed annexing three li from Shanglin and relocating the Fenghua county seat there.

sentences.zh: 蓋寓犬牙相錯之意。

translations.literal: This embodied the idea of interlocking territories like dogs' teeth.
translations.idiomatic: This embodied the principle of interlocking territories like the teeth of a dog.

sentences.zh: 巡撫林富謂遷郡及割止戈裏應如守仁議，至以三里當設衛，而並鳳化縣裁之，遂令府治益孤。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Lin Fu held that relocating the prefectural seat and annexing Zhige district should follow Wang Shouren's proposal, but that using the three li for a guard post and abolishing Fenghua County together left the prefectural seat increasingly isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Lin Fu agreed with Wang Shouren on relocating the prefectural seat and annexing Zhige district, but by using the three li for a guard post and abolishing Fenghua County at the same time, he left the prefectural seat ever more isolated.

sentences.zh: 其後九司頭目日恣，所轄蠻民不堪，知府陳璜曲加綏戢。

translations.literal: Thereafter the nine subprefecture headmen grew daily more unrestrained; the tribal people under their rule could not bear it, and Prefectural Commissioner Chen Huang gently tried to pacify and restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the headmen of the nine subprefectures grew daily more arrogant; the tribal peoples under them could not endure it, and Prefect Chen Huang tried to soothe and restrain them as best he could.

sentences.zh: 目把劉觀、盧回以復土為名，鼓眾作亂。

translations.literal: Subofficial officers Liu Guan and Lu Hui, under the banner of restoring native rule, rallied the masses in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Subofficial officers Liu Guan and Lu Hui raised a rebellion under the banner of restoring the native chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 副使翁萬達因有事安南，計擒盧回殺之，招回從亂者三十余人。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Weng Wanda, because he had business in Annam, schemed to capture Lu Hui and killed him, and persuaded more than thirty followers of the rebellion to return.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Weng Wanda, while occupied with affairs in Annam, devised a plan to capture Lu Hui and had him killed, then persuaded more than thirty rebels to surrender.

sentences.zh: 最後東蘭岑瑄詐稱岑浚子起雲，謀復土官，為九司頭目所縛。

translations.literal: Finally, Donglan's Cen Xuan falsely claimed to be Qiyun, son of Cen Jun, plotting to restore the native official system, and was bound by the nine subprefecture headmen.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Cen Xuan of Donglan falsely claimed to be Qiyun, son of Cen Jun, and plotted to restore the native chieftaincy; the headmen of the nine subprefectures seized and bound him.

sentences.zh: 萬歷七年，督撫吳文華謂九司日以驕黠，編氓甚少，緩急難恃，奏割南寧武緣縣屬思恩，自是思恩稱巨鎮雲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wanli, Governor and Grand Coordinator Wu Wenhua said the nine subprefectures grew daily more arrogant and cunning, registered households were very few, and in emergencies they could not be relied upon; he memorialized to annex Wuyuan County under Nanning to Si'en, and from then on Si'en came to be called a great garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: In 1579, Governor and Grand Coordinator Wu Wenhua argued that the nine subprefectures were growing daily more arrogant and cunning, that registered households were too few to rely on in an emergency, and memorialized to annex Wuyuan County of Nanning to Si'en; from then on Si'en came to be called a great garrison post.

sentences.zh: 思恩府土巡檢九司，皆嘉靖七年設，曰興隆，曰那馬，曰白山，曰定羅，曰舊城，曰下旺，曰安定，曰都陽，曰古零。

translations.literal: The nine native subprefectures of Si'en Prefecture were all established in the seventh year of Jiajing: Xinglong, Nama, Baishan, Dingluo, Jiucheng, Xiwang, Anding, Duyang, and Guling.
translations.idiomatic: Si'en Prefecture's nine native subprefectures were all established in 1528: Xinglong, Nama, Baishan, Dingluo, Jiucheng, Xiwang, Anding, Duyang, and Guling.

sentences.zh: 鎮安，宋時於鎮安峒建右江軍民宣撫司，元改鎮安路。

translations.literal: At Zhen’an, in the Song the Youjiang Military-Civilian Pacification Office was established at Zhen’an Cave; in the Yuan it was changed to Zhen’an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhen’an, in the Song the Youjiang Military-Civilian Pacification Office was established at Zhen’an Cave; in the Yuan it was changed to Zhen’an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明洪武元年，鎮安歸附。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu of the Ming, Zhen’an submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu of the Ming, Zhen’an submitted.

sentences.zh: 以舊治僻遠，移建廢凍州，改為府。

translations.literal: Because the old seat was remote and out of the way, it was moved to the abandoned Dong Prefecture and changed into a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because the old seat was remote and out of the way, it was moved to the abandoned Dong Prefecture and changed into a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 授土官岑添保知府，朝貢如例。

translations.literal: The native official Cen Tianbao was appointed prefect, and tribute to court followed the regular precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The native official Cen Tianbao was appointed prefect, and tribute to court followed the regular precedent.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，添保上言：「往者征南將軍傅友德令郡民歲輸米三千石，運雲南普安衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Tianbao submitted, “Previously General Who Campaigns in the South Fu Youde ordered the commandery people each year to pay three thousand shi of rice and transport it to Pu’an Guard in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Tianbao submitted, “Previously General Who Campaigns in the South Fu Youde ordered the commandery people each year to pay three thousand shi of rice and transport it to Pu’an Guard in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 鎮安僻處溪洞，南接交阯，孤立一方，且無所屬。

translations.literal: Zhen’an lies remote among streams and caves, borders Jiaozhi to the south, stands isolated in one quarter, and has no superior jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen’an lies remote among streams and caves, borders Jiaozhi to the south, stands isolated in one quarter, and has no superior jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 州縣人民鮮少，舟車不通，陸行二十五日始到普安。

translations.literal: The people of its prefectures and counties are very few, boats and carts do not pass through, and only after twenty-five days’ travel by land does one reach Pu’an.
translations.idiomatic: The people of its prefectures and counties are very few, boats and carts do not pass through, and only after twenty-five days’ travel by land does one reach Pu’an.

sentences.zh: 道遠而險，一夫負米三鬥，給食余所存無幾，往往以耕牛及他物至其地易米輸納。

translations.literal: The road is long and dangerous; one man carries three dou of rice, and after provisions for the journey almost nothing remains, so they often take plow oxen and other goods there to exchange for rice to pay the quota.
translations.idiomatic: The road is long and dangerous; one man carries three dou of rice, and after provisions for the journey almost nothing remains, so they often take plow oxen and other goods there to exchange for rice to pay the quota.

sentences.zh: 而普安荒遠，米不易得，民甚病之。

translations.literal: Moreover Pu’an is desolate and distant, rice is not easy to obtain, and the people suffer greatly from this.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Pu’an is desolate and distant, rice is not easy to obtain, and the people suffer greatly from this.

sentences.zh: 又歲輸本衛米四百石，尤極艱難。

translations.literal: They also annually pay four hundred shi of rice to the local guard, which is still more extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: They also annually pay four hundred shi of rice to the local guard, which is still more extremely difficult.

sentences.zh: 舊以白金一兩，折納一石。

translations.literal: Formerly one liang of silver was commuted as payment for one shi.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one liang of silver was commuted as payment for one shi.

sentences.zh: 今願依前例，以蘇民困。」

translations.literal: Now I request that the former precedent be followed, in order to relieve the people’s distress.”
translations.idiomatic: Now I request that the former precedent be followed, in order to relieve the people’s distress.”

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，向武知州黃世鐵侵奪鎮安高寨等地，朝廷遣兵討平之，以其地屬鎮安。

translations.literal: In the Yongle reign, Xiangwu Prefect Huang Shitie encroached on and seized Gaozhai and other places in Zhen'an; the court dispatched troops to suppress and pacify him, and assigned those lands to Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongle reign, Xiangwu Prefect Huang Shitie seized Gaozhai and other territories belonging to Zhen'an; the court sent troops to suppress him and assigned those lands to Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 成化八年，知府岑永壽侄宗紹糾集土兵，攻破府治，殺傷嫡母，流劫鄉村，有司撫諭不服，都指揮岑瑛擒斬之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chenghua, Prefectural Commissioner Cen Yongshou's nephew Zongshao gathered native troops, broke into the prefectural seat, killed and wounded his stepmother, and raided villages in plunder; when officials tried to pacify and instruct him he would not submit, and Guard Commander Cen Ying captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1472, Zongshao, nephew of Prefect Cen Yongshou, raised native troops, stormed the prefectural seat, killed and wounded his stepmother, and raided the countryside. When officials tried to pacify him he refused to submit, and Guard Commander Cen Ying captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十四年，田州盧蘇作亂，糾歸順州土官岑瓛攻毀鎮安府，目兵遇害者以萬計。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiajing, Tianzhou's Lu Su rebelled, incited Guishun Prefecture native official Cen Fan to attack and destroy Zhen'an Prefecture, and tribal soldiers killed numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In 1535, Lu Su of Tianzhou rebelled and incited Guishun native official Cen Fan to attack and destroy Zhen'an Prefecture; tribal soldiers killed numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 按臣曾守約以聞，帝命守臣治之。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Zeng Shouyue reported the matter; the emperor ordered the resident officials to deal with it.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Zeng Shouyue reported the affair, and the emperor ordered the local officials to handle it.

sentences.zh: 時蘇倡亂，田州無主，鎮安府土官男岑真寶以兵納岑邦佐於田州。

translations.literal: At that time Lu Su had stirred rebellion and Tianzhou had no ruler; Zhen'an Prefecture native official's son Cen Zhenbao led troops to install Cen Bangzuo in Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Lu Su had raised the rebellion and Tianzhou had no ruler; Cen Zhenbao, son of the Zhen'an native official, led troops to install Cen Bangzuo in Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 歸順州岑瓛，蘇婿也，及向武州黃仲金皆與真寶隙，乘真寶入田州，蘇遣瓛及仲金襲破鎮安。

translations.literal: Guishun Prefecture's Cen Fan, who was Lu Su's son-in-law, and Xiangwu Prefecture's Huang Zhongjin were both at odds with Zhenbao; when Zhenbao entered Tianzhou, Lu Su sent Fan and Zhongjin to raid and break into Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Fan of Guishun, Lu Su's son-in-law, and Huang Zhongjin of Xiangwu were both at odds with Zhenbao; while Zhenbao was in Tianzhou, Lu Su sent Fan and Zhongjin to storm and seize Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 真寶聞亂，走還。

translations.literal: When Zhenbao heard of the turmoil, he fled back.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenbao heard of the upheaval, he hurried back.

sentences.zh: 蘇會目兵追圍之武陵寨，瓛等遂發真寶父母墓，焚其骸，分兵占據諸洞寨。

translations.literal: Lu Su joined tribal soldiers in pursuing and besieging him at Wuling Stockade; Fan and the others then opened the tombs of Zhenbao's parents, burned their remains, and divided troops to occupy the various cave stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Su rallied tribal soldiers to pursue and besiege him at Wuling Stockade; Fan and his allies then desecrated the tombs of Zhenbao's parents, burned their remains, and sent troops to occupy the surrounding cave stockades.

sentences.zh: 真寶訴之軍門，督諭瓛等不退。

translations.literal: Zhenbao appealed to headquarters; the governor admonished Fan and the others, but they would not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenbao appealed to headquarters, but though the governor admonished Fan and his allies, they refused to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 久之乃解，官軍歸真寶，於是瓛與真寶互相訐。

translations.literal: Only after a long time was the matter resolved; government troops were returned to Zhenbao, and thereupon Fan and Zhenbao accused each other.
translations.idiomatic: Only after a long standoff was the crisis resolved and government troops restored to Zhenbao; Fan and Zhenbao then filed mutual accusations against each other.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史言，土蠻自相仇，非有所侵犯，從末減。

translations.literal: The touring censor reported that the native tribes were feuding among themselves without encroaching on others, and punishment should be leniently reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The touring censor argued that the native chieftains were feuding among themselves without encroaching on imperial territory, and recommended lenient reductions in punishment.

sentences.zh: 於是蘇、瓛、仲金各降罰有差，真寶亦革冠帶，許立功自贖。

translations.literal: Thereupon Lu Su, Fan, and Zhongjin each received demotions and punishments of varying degree; Zhenbao also had his official cap and belt removed, but was permitted to redeem himself through meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Lu Su, Fan, and Zhongjin were demoted and punished to varying degrees; Zhenbao was also stripped of his official insignia but allowed to redeem himself through meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 二十二年以瑤、僮作亂，防禦需人，免真寶諸土官來朝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because the Yao and Zhuang rebelled and defense required personnel, Zhenbao and the other native officials were exempted from coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, with Yao and Zhuang uprisings demanding every available defender, Zhenbao and the other native officials were exempted from the obligation to attend court.

sentences.zh: 鎮安所屬有上映洞、湖潤寨。

translations.literal: Under Zhen'an were Shangying Cave and Hurun Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen'an included Shangying Cave and Hurun Stockade.

sentences.zh: 巡檢皆土人，世官。

translations.literal: The patrol inspectors were all local natives, holding hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: The patrol inspectors were all drawn from the local population and held hereditary posts.

sentences.zh: 田州，古百粵地。

translations.literal: Tianzhou was ancient Baiyue territory.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhou had been Baiyue territory in antiquity.

sentences.zh: 漢屬交阯郡。

translations.literal: Under Han it belonged to Jiaozhi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it fell within Jiaozhi Commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐隸邕州都督府。

translations.literal: Under Tang it was subordinate to the Yong Prefecture Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was placed under the Yong Prefecture Area Command.

sentences.zh: 宋始置田州，屬邕州橫山寨。

translations.literal: Song first established Tianzhou, subordinate to Yong Prefecture's Hengshan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song first established Tianzhou, placing it under the Hengshan Stockade of Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元改置田州路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Yuan reorganized it as the Tianzhou Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan reorganized it as the Tianzhou Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 明興，改田州府，省來安府入焉。

translations.literal: When Ming arose, it was changed to Tianzhou Prefecture, and Lai'an Prefecture was abolished and incorporated into it.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming dynasty was established, the region became Tianzhou Prefecture, with Lai'an Prefecture abolished and absorbed into it.

sentences.zh: 後改田州，領縣一，曰上林。

translations.literal: Later it was changed to Tianzhou, administering one county called Shanglin.
translations.idiomatic: It was later renamed Tianzhou and administered a single county, Shanglin.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，大兵下廣西，右江田州府土官岑伯顏遣使賫印詣平章楊璟降。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, when the great army took Guangxi, Cen Boyan, native official of Youjiang Tianzhou Prefecture, sent envoys carrying his seal to surrender to Administrative Commissioner Yang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, when the great army took Guangxi, Cen Boyan, native official of Youjiang Tianzhou Prefecture, sent envoys carrying his seal to surrender to Administrative Commissioner Yang Jing.

sentences.zh: 二年，伯顏遣使奉表貢馬及方物，詔以伯顏為田州知府，世襲，自是朝貢如制。

translations.literal: In the second year, Boyan sent envoys to present a memorial and offer tribute horses and local products; an edict made Boyan prefect of Tianzhou, hereditary in succession, and from then on tribute to court followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Boyan sent envoys to present a memorial and offer tribute horses and local products; an edict made Boyan prefect of Tianzhou, hereditary in succession, and from then on tribute to court followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 六年，田州溪峒蠻賊竊發，伯顏討平之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Man bandits in the streams and cave districts of Tianzhou rose in stealth, and Boyan campaigned against and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Man bandits in the streams and cave districts of Tianzhou rose in stealth, and Boyan campaigned against and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 伯顏請振安州、順龍州、侯州、陽縣、羅博州、龍威寨人民，詔有司各給牛米，仍蠲其稅二年。

translations.literal: Boyan requested relief for the people of Zhen’an Prefecture, Shunlong Prefecture, Hou Prefecture, Yang County, Luobo Prefecture, and Longwei Stockade; an edict ordered the offices concerned to give each oxen and rice, and also remitted their taxes for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Boyan requested relief for the people of Zhen’an Prefecture, Shunlong Prefecture, Hou Prefecture, Yang County, Luobo Prefecture, and Longwei Stockade; an edict ordered the offices concerned to give each oxen and rice, and also remitted their taxes for two years.

sentences.zh: 十六年，伯顏死，子堅襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Boyan died, and his son Jian succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Boyan died, and his son Jian succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十七年，都指揮使耿良奏：「田州知府岑堅、泗州知州岑善忠率其土兵，討捕瑤寇，多樹功績。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Regional Military Commissioner Geng Liang memorialized, “Tianzhou Prefect Cen Jian and Sizhou Prefect Cen Shanzhong led their native troops to campaign against and capture Yao bandits, establishing many achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Regional Military Commissioner Geng Liang memorialized, “Tianzhou Prefect Cen Jian and Sizhou Prefect Cen Shanzhong led their native troops to campaign against and capture Yao bandits, establishing many achievements.

sentences.zh: 臣欲令選取壯丁各五千人，立二衛，以善忠之子振，堅之子永通為千戶，統眾守禦，且耕且戰，此古人以蠻攻蠻之術也。」

translations.literal: I wish to have them each select five thousand strong men and establish two guards, with Shanzhong’s son Zhen and Jian’s son Yongtong as company commanders, to command the men for defense, both farming and fighting; this is the ancient method of using Man to attack Man.”
translations.idiomatic: I wish to have them each select five thousand strong men and establish two guards, with Shanzhong’s son Zhen and Jian’s son Yongtong as company commanders, to command the men for defense, both farming and fighting; this is the ancient method of using Man to attack Man.”

sentences.zh: 詔行其言。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that his proposal be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that his proposal be carried out.

sentences.zh: 二十年，堅遣子思恩知州永昌朝貢，如例給賜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Jian sent his son Yongchang, prefectural magistrate of Si’en, to attend court and offer tribute, and gifts were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Jian sent his son Yongchang, prefectural magistrate of Si’en, to attend court and offer tribute, and gifts were granted according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，堅死，子永通襲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, Jian died, and his son Yongtong succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle, Cen Jian died and was succeeded by his son Yongtong.

sentences.zh: 永通，上隆州知州也，州以瓊代，而己襲父職。

translations.literal: Yongtong was magistrate of Shanglong Prefecture; the prefecture was given to Qiong in his place, while he himself inherited his father's office.
translations.idiomatic: Yongtong had been magistrate of Shanglong Prefecture; Qiong was appointed in his place there, while he himself inherited his father's post at Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 正統八年，賜知府岑紹誥命，並封贈其父母妻。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhengtong, Prefect Cen Shao was granted an edict of appointment, and his parents and wife were ennobled and posthumously honored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhengtong, Prefect Cen Shao received an edict of appointment, and titles were conferred on his parents and wife.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，田州頭目呂趙偽稱敵國大將軍，張旗幟，鳴鉦鼓，率眾劫掠南丹州，又據向武州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun, the Tianzhou chieftain Lü Zhao falsely styled himself Grand General of a Rival State, raised banners and flags, sounded gongs and drums, led a host to plunder Nandan Prefecture, and also seized Xiangwu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianshun, the Tianzhou chieftain Lü Zhao proclaimed himself Grand General of a Rival State, raised banners, beat gongs and drums, led his followers in raids on Nandan Prefecture, and seized Xiangwu Prefecture as well.

sentences.zh: 武進伯朱瑛以聞，兵部請命瑛及土官岑瑛剿捕。

translations.literal: Marquis of Wujin Zhu Ying reported this; the Ministry of War requested that Ying and the native official Cen Ying be ordered to suppress and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Wujin Zhu Ying reported the matter, and the Ministry of War requested orders for him and the native official Cen Ying to suppress and capture the rebel.

sentences.zh: 三年，巡撫葉盛奏：「田州叛目呂趙勢愈獗，殺知府岑鑒，占據地方，偽稱太平王，圖謀岑氏宗族，冒襲知府職事。」

translations.literal: In the third year, Grand Coordinator Ye Sheng memorialized, "The Tianzhou rebel chieftain Lü Zhao grows ever bolder: he has killed Prefect Cen Jian, seized territory, falsely proclaimed himself King of Taiping, plotted against the Cen clan, and usurped the prefect's office."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Grand Coordinator Ye Sheng memorialized, "The Tianzhou rebel chieftain Lü Zhao grows ever bolder: he has killed Prefect Cen Jian, seized territory, falsely proclaimed himself King of Taiping, plotted against the Cen clan, and usurped the prefect's office."

sentences.zh: 帝命總兵速討。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the regional commander to suppress him quickly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the regional commander to move against him at once.

sentences.zh: 四年，巡按御史吳禎奏：「奉敕剿捕反賊呂趙，選調官軍土兵，攻破功饒、婪鳳二關，直搗府城。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Touring Censor Wu Zhen memorialized: "In obedience to the imperial command to suppress and capture the rebel Lü Zhao, selected government troops and native soldiers were mustered; Gongrao and Lanfeng passes were stormed, and the army advanced straight upon the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Touring Censor Wu Zhen reported: "Acting on the imperial command to suppress the rebel Lü Zhao, we mustered government troops and native soldiers, stormed the Gongrao and Lanfeng passes, and advanced straight on the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 呂趙攜妻子，挾知州岑鐸等宵遁。

translations.literal: Lü Zhao took his wife and children, seized Magistrate Cen Duo and others, and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Zhao fled by night with his wife and children, taking Magistrate Cen Duo and others with him.

sentences.zh: 官軍追至雲南富州，奪回鐸等及其子若婿。

translations.literal: Government troops pursued them to Funzhou in Yunnan, recovered Duo and the others along with his sons and sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops pursued them as far as Funzhou in Yunnan, recovering Duo and the others along with his sons and sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 斬首四十九級，賊眾悉降。

translations.literal: Forty-nine heads were severed, and the bandit host all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-nine heads were taken, and the rebel forces surrendered en masse.

sentences.zh: 趙以數騎走鎮安府，追及之，斬趙及其子四人，從賊十八人，獲其妻孥及偽太平王木印、無敵將軍銅印，並鳳旗盔甲等物。

translations.literal: Zhao fled with a few horsemen to Zhen'an Prefecture; they overtook him, beheaded Zhao and his four sons and eighteen followers, and seized his wife and children, the wooden seal of the false King of Taiping, the bronze seal of Invincible General, and phoenix banners, helmets, armor, and other items.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao fled with a handful of horsemen toward Zhen'an Prefecture; pursuers overtook him, executed Zhao, his four sons, and eighteen followers, and captured his family, the counterfeit wooden seal of the King of Taiping, the bronze seal of Invincible General, and phoenix banners, helmets, armor, and other regalia.

sentences.zh: 復委知府岑鏞仍掌府事，撫安人民。」

translations.literal: Prefect Cen Yong was again placed in charge of the prefecture to pacify and settle the people."
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Cen Yong was again placed in charge of the prefecture to pacify and settle the people."

sentences.zh: 田州平，帝遣使賫敕獎諭禎等，並敕鏞謹守法度，保全宗族。

translations.literal: Tianzhou was pacified; the emperor dispatched envoys bearing edicts to reward and admonish Zhen and the others, and also ordered Yong to carefully observe the law and preserve his clan.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhou was pacified. The emperor sent envoys with edicts commending Zhen and his colleagues, and also instructed Yong to uphold the law and safeguard his clan.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，遣兵科給事中王秉彜賫敕諭鏞，並賜銀幣，以兵部言其所部土官狼兵，屢調剿有勞，且有事於大藤峽也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua, Supervising Secretary Wang Bingyi of the Bureau of Military Affairs was dispatched bearing an edict to instruct Yong, and silver and silks were bestowed, because the Ministry of War reported that the Lang troops under his native officials had repeatedly been mobilized for suppression with meritorious service, and moreover had seen action at the Great Vine Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chenghua, Supervising Secretary Wang Bingyi of the Bureau of Military Affairs was sent with an edict to address Yong and bestow silver and silks, in recognition of the Ministry of War's report that the Lang troops under his native officials had repeatedly distinguished themselves in suppressive campaigns, including action at the Great Vine Gorge.

sentences.zh: 二年，總兵官趙輔奏鏞從征有功，請給誥命，旌其父母並妻，從之。

translations.literal: In the second year, Regional Commander Zhao Fu memorialized that Yong had merit from following on campaign; he requested an edict of appointment and honors for his parents and wife—the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Regional Commander Zhao Fu reported Yong's meritorious service on campaign and requested an edict of appointment and honors for his parents and wife; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，復以輔言，予鏞官誥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, again on Fu's recommendation, Yong was granted an official edict of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, again on Fu's recommendation, Yong received an official patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 十六年，田州頭目黃明聚眾為亂，知府岑溥走避思恩。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Tianzhou chieftain Huang Ming gathered a host and raised rebellion; Prefect Cen Pu fled to Si'en for refuge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the Tianzhou chieftain Huang Ming rose in rebellion; Prefect Cen Pu fled to Si'en for safety.

sentences.zh: 總督朱英調參將馬義率軍捕明，明敗走，為恩城知州岑欽所執，並族屬誅之。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhu Ying mobilized Vice Commander Ma Yi to lead troops to capture Ming; Ming was defeated and fled, was seized by Encheng Magistrate Cen Qin, and he and his clansmen were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhu Ying dispatched Vice Commander Ma Yi to capture Huang Ming; Ming was defeated and fled but was seized by Encheng Magistrate Cen Qin, who executed him and his entire clan.

sentences.zh: 已，溥復與欽交惡。

translations.literal: Afterward, Pu again fell into mutual enmity with Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Pu and Qin were at odds again.

sentences.zh: 欽攻奪田州，逐溥，殺五十余家。

translations.literal: Qin attacked and seized Tianzhou, drove Pu away, and killed more than fifty households.
translations.idiomatic: Qin attacked and seized Tianzhou, drove Pu out, and slaughtered more than fifty households.

sentences.zh: 時泗城州岑應方恃兵強，復黨欽，殺擄人民二萬六千余，與欽分割田州而據其地。

translations.literal: At the time, Sicheng Prefecture's Cen Yingfang, relying on military strength, again allied with Qin; they killed and abducted more than twenty-six thousand people, divided Tianzhou with Qin, and occupied its territory.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Cen Yingfang of Sicheng Prefecture, confident in his military strength, rallied to Qin's side; together they killed or abducted more than twenty-six thousand people, divided Tianzhou between them, and seized its territory.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年，總制遣官護溥之子猇入田，為欽所遏，居潯州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongzhi, the supreme commander dispatched officials to escort Pu's son Miao into Tianzhou; he was blocked by Qin and took up residence at Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongzhi, the supreme commander sent officials to escort Pu's son Miao into Tianzhou, but Qin blocked their way and Miao remained at Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 按察使陶魯率官軍次南寧，欽拒敵，敗走。

translations.literal: Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Tao Lu led government troops to encamp at Nanning; Qin resisted but was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Tao Lu led government troops to Nanning; Qin offered resistance but was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 而應復援之入城，陳兵以備。

translations.literal: Yingfang then came to his aid and entered the city, deploying troops in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: Yingfang then reinforced him and entered the city, arraying troops in defense.

sentences.zh: 巡撫秦纮請合貴州、湖廣及兩廣兵剿之，欽勢蹙，乞兵於應，遂匿應所，總鎮官因檄應捕欽。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Qin Hong requested combined troops from Guizhou, Huguang, and the Two Guangs to suppress them; Qin's situation grew desperate; he begged troops from Yingfang and then hid at Yingfang's headquarters; the supreme military commander thereupon issued orders to Yingfang to capture Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Qin Hong called for a joint campaign by troops from Guizhou, Huguang, and the Two Guangs; pressed hard, Qin begged Yingfang for aid and then took refuge with him; the supreme commander responded by ordering Yingfang to capture Qin.

sentences.zh: 欽從應飲，殺應父子於坐，收其兵以拒官軍。

translations.literal: While drinking with Yingfang, Qin killed Yingfang and his son at the table, gathered their troops, and resisted the government army.
translations.idiomatic: At a banquet with Yingfang, Qin killed Yingfang and his son on the spot, seized their forces, and turned to resist the government troops.

sentences.zh: 已而應弟岑接佯以兵送欽至田州界，亦殺其父子以報。

translations.literal: Before long, Yingfang's younger brother Cen Jie feigned escorting Qin with troops to the Tianzhou border, and likewise killed Qin and his son in revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Yingfang's younger brother Cen Jie feigned escorting Qin to the Tianzhou border with troops and killed Qin and his son in revenge.

sentences.zh: 事聞，廷議仍命溥還田州。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, court deliberation again ordered Pu to return to Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the capital, the court decided that Pu should be restored to Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，總督鄧廷瓚言溥前以罪革職，比隨征有功，乞復其冠帶，領土兵赴梧州聽調，從之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Governor-General Deng Tingzan reported that Pu had previously been dismissed for crimes but had since earned merit on campaign; he begged restoration of his cap and belt and permission to lead native troops to Wuzhou awaiting orders—the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Governor-General Deng Tingzan reported that although Pu had been dismissed for misconduct, he had since distinguished himself on campaign; he requested restoration of his official rank and permission to lead native troops to Wuzhou for deployment; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二年，溥為子猇所弒，猇亦自殺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Pu was assassinated by his son Miao, who then killed himself as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Pu was murdered by his son Miao, who then took his own life.

sentences.zh: 次子猛方四歲，溥母岑氏及頭目黃驥護之，赴制府告襲。

translations.literal: The second son Meng was only four years old; Pu's mother Lady Cen and the chieftain Huang Ji protected him and went to provincial headquarters to petition for succession.
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Meng, was only four; Pu's mother Lady Cen and the chieftain Huang Ji protected him and traveled to provincial headquarters to petition for his succession.

sentences.zh: 歸至南寧，頭目李蠻來迎。

translations.literal: On the return to Nanning, the chieftain Li Man came to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: On their return to Nanning, the chieftain Li Man came out to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 驥慮蠻奪己權，殺其使。

translations.literal: Ji feared that Man would seize his authority and killed Man's messenger.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, fearing that Man would usurp his authority, killed Man's envoy.

sentences.zh: 蠻率兵至舊田州，驥懼，誣蠻將為變，乞以兵納，乃調思恩岑浚率兵衛猛。

translations.literal: Man led troops to Old Tianzhou; Ji grew afraid, falsely accused Man of plotting rebellion, and requested troops to escort Meng in; Si'en's Cen Jun was then mobilized to lead troops guarding Meng.
translations.idiomatic: Man marched on Old Tianzhou; terrified, Ji falsely accused Man of plotting rebellion and requested military escort for Meng's installation; Cen Jun of Si'en was dispatched with troops to guard the boy.

sentences.zh: 浚受驥賂，納其女，挾猛，約分其六甲地。

translations.literal: Jun accepted Ji's bribes, took his daughter in marriage, seized control of Meng, and agreed to divide the six jia districts between them.
translations.idiomatic: Jun accepted Ji's bribes, married his daughter, seized control of young Meng, and agreed to a division of the six jia districts between them.

sentences.zh: 比至田州，蠻拒不納，驥復以猛奔思恩，幽之。

translations.literal: When they reached Tianzhou, Man refused to admit them; Ji again fled with Meng to Si'en and confined him there.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Tianzhou, Man refused them entry; Ji then fled with Meng to Si'en and held him in secret confinement.

sentences.zh: 事覺，廷瓚檄副總兵歐磐等攝浚，久乃出猛，置於會城。

translations.literal: When the affair came to light, Tingzan issued orders for Vice Commander Ou Pan and others to detain Jun; only after a long time was Meng released and placed in the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the scheme was exposed, Tingzan ordered Vice Commander Ou Pan and others to take Jun into custody; only after considerable delay was Meng freed and placed in the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 得奏，命猛襲知府。

translations.literal: Upon receiving the memorial, the emperor ordered Meng to succeed as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On receiving the report, the court authorized Meng to succeed as prefect.

sentences.zh: 驥、浚怒其事之不由己出也，要泗城岑接、東蘭韋祖鋐各起兵攻蠻。

translations.literal: Ji and Jun, angry that matters had not gone their way, incited Cen Jie of Sicheng and Wei Zutong of Donglan each to raise troops and attack Man.
translations.idiomatic: Furious that events had slipped beyond their control, Ji and Jun incited Cen Jie of Sicheng and Wei Zutong of Donglan to raise armies against Man.

sentences.zh: 接兵二萬先入田州，殺掠男女八百余人，驅之溺水死者無算，括府庫，放兵大掠，城郭為墟。

translations.literal: Jie's army of twenty thousand entered Tianzhou first, killed and plundered more than eight hundred men and women, drove many to drown with numbers beyond count, emptied the treasury, let the troops loot freely, and reduced the walled city to ruins.
translations.idiomatic: Jie's force of twenty thousand entered Tianzhou first, slaughtering and plundering more than eight hundred men and women; countless victims were driven into the water to drown; the treasury was stripped bare and the troops unleashed in a general rampage until the city lay in ruins.

sentences.zh: 浚兵二萬攻舊田州，據之，殺掠男女五千三百余人，蠻逃去。

translations.literal: Jun's army of twenty thousand attacked Old Tianzhou, seized it, killed and plundered more than five thousand three hundred men and women, and Man fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's army of twenty thousand stormed Old Tianzhou, seized it, killed or plundered more than five thousand three hundred men and women, and Man fled.

sentences.zh: 副總兵歐磐、參政武清等詣田州府勘治，遣兵送猛還府。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Ou Pan, Administrator Wu Qing, and others went to Tianzhou Prefecture to investigate and settle matters, and dispatched troops to escort Meng back to the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Ou Pan, Administrator Wu Qing, and others went to Tianzhou to investigate and restore order, escorting Meng back to the prefectural seat under military guard.

sentences.zh: 驥懼罪，匿浚家，有司請治浚罪。

translations.literal: Ji feared punishment and hid in Jun's household; the local authorities requested that Jun be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, fearing prosecution, took refuge in Jun's household; the local authorities petitioned for Jun's punishment.

sentences.zh: 初，蠻之迎猛也，無他念，及猛在外，蠻守土以待其歸。

translations.literal: At first, when Man came to welcome Meng, he had no ulterior motive; while Meng was away, Man held the territory awaiting his return.
translations.idiomatic: At first Man's welcome of Meng had been sincere; while the boy was held elsewhere, Man maintained the territory in expectation of his return.

sentences.zh: 驥爭權首亂，浚、接、祖鋐黨惡，以致茲變。

translations.literal: Ji sought power and was first to stir disorder; Jun, Jie, and Zutong formed a wicked faction, bringing about this calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Ji had provoked the disorder in his bid for power; Jun, Jie, and Zutong had abetted the violence, and together they brought on this disaster.

sentences.zh: 清受浚賂，曲右之，且誣蠻占據府治，阻兵弄權，事竟不直。

translations.literal: Qing accepted Jun's bribes, bent the law in his favor, and moreover falsely accused Man of occupying the prefectural seat, blocking troops and wielding power—the matter was ultimately not set right.
translations.idiomatic: Qing had accepted Jun's bribes, ruled in his favor, and falsely accused Man of seizing the prefectural seat and manipulating military power; justice was never done.

sentences.zh: 於是廷瓚言思恩岑浚罪惡，正在逐捕，而田州岑猛亦宜乘此區畫，降府為州，毋基異日尾大之患，從之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Tingzan reported that Cen Jun of Si'en was guilty and fugitive and should be pursued, and that Cen Meng of Tianzhou should also at this juncture be reorganized by reducing the prefecture to a subprefecture, lest the problem of a power grown too large to control be laid for the future—the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzan then argued that Cen Jun of Si'en should be hunted down for his crimes, and that Cen Meng of Tianzhou should at the same time be reorganized by demoting Tianzhou from a prefecture to a subprefecture, lest the region again grow too powerful to control; the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年，廷議以思、田既平，宜設流官；

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, court deliberation held that since Si'en and Tianzhou were now pacified, regular officials should be appointed;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the court concluded that with Si'en and Tianzhou pacified, the time had come to appoint regular officials;

sentences.zh: 岑猛世濟兇惡，致陷府治，宜降授千戶，而遴選才望者假以方面職銜，守田州，仍賜敕以重其權。

translations.literal: Cen Meng's line had generation after generation accumulated wickedness and brought the prefectural seat to ruin; he should be demoted and granted the rank of company commander, while a man of talent and reputation should be selected and given a provincial-level title to govern Tianzhou, with an edict still bestowed to enhance his authority.
translations.idiomatic: The Cen line had bred violence for generations and brought the prefectural seat to ruin; Meng should be demoted to company commander, while a man of talent and standing should be selected, given a provincial-level title, and placed in charge of Tianzhou, with an edict to bolster his authority.

sentences.zh: 帝然之，於是以平樂知府謝湖為右參政，掌府事。

translations.literal: The emperor approved; thereupon Pingyue Prefect Xie Hu was appointed Right Vice Administrator to administer the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed, and Pingyue Prefect Xie Hu was appointed Right Vice Administrator with charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時岑猛已降福建平海衛千戶，遷延不行。

translations.literal: At the time Cen Meng had already been demoted to company commander of the Pinghai Guard in Fujian, but delayed and would not go.
translations.idiomatic: By then Cen Meng had been demoted to company commander of Fujian's Pinghai Guard, but he stalled and refused to depart.

sentences.zh: 及湖至，復陳兵自衛，令祖母岑氏奏乞於廣西極邊率部下立功，以便祭養，詔總鎮官詳議以聞。

translations.literal: When Hu arrived, Meng again deployed troops in self-defense, had his grandmother Lady Cen memorialize begging to lead his followers in merit at the extreme frontier of Guangxi so as to support ancestral rites; an edict ordered the supreme commander to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu arrived, Meng again mustered troops in self-defense and had his grandmother Lady Cen petition the throne to lead his followers in frontier service in the remotest parts of Guangxi, so that he might earn merit and support ancestral rites; the emperor ordered the supreme commander to deliberate and report back.

sentences.zh: 總督陳金奏：「猛據舊巢，要求府佐，不赴平海衛。

translations.literal: Governor-General Chen Jin memorialized: "Meng occupies his old stronghold, demands a deputy prefect, and will not go to Pinghai Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Chen Jin reported: "Meng holds his old stronghold, demands a deputy prefect, and refuses to report to Pinghai Guard.

sentences.zh: 參政謝湖不即赴任，為猛所拒，納饋遺而徇其要求，宜逮間。」

translations.literal: Vice Administrator Xie Hu failed to take up his post promptly, was rebuffed by Meng, accepted gifts, and indulged his demands; he should be arrested and interrogated."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Administrator Xie Hu failed to take up his post promptly, was rebuffed by Meng, accepted gifts, and indulged his demands; he should be arrested and interrogated."

sentences.zh: 時猛遣人重賂劉瑾，得旨，留猛而褫湖，並及前撫潘蕃、劉大夏，猛竟得以同知攝府事。

translations.literal: At the time Meng sent men to bribe Liu Jin heavily; he obtained an edict keeping Meng in place while stripping Hu of office, implicating the former grand coordinators Pan Fan and Liu Daxia as well; Meng ultimately managed to serve as acting prefect in the capacity of Assistant Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Meng had meanwhile sent agents to bribe Liu Jin lavishly; an edict arrived keeping Meng in place while dismissing Hu and implicating former grand coordinators Pan Fan and Liu Daxia; Meng thus secured appointment as acting prefect in the rank of Assistant Prefect.

sentences.zh: 猛撫輯遺民，兵復振，稍復侵旁郡自廣。

translations.literal: Meng pacified the surviving populace, his forces revived, and he gradually encroached again on neighboring prefectures to expand his domain.
translations.idiomatic: Meng rallied the displaced populace, rebuilt his forces, and gradually encroached on neighboring prefectures to expand his domain.

sentences.zh: 嘗言督撫有調發，願立功，冀復舊職。

translations.literal: He often said that if the governor-general or grand coordinator had need of mobilization, he was willing to earn merit in hopes of recovering his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He often declared that whenever the provincial authorities mobilized troops, he stood ready to earn merit in hope of recovering his former rank.

sentences.zh: 會江西盜起，都御史陳金檄猛從征，猛所至剽掠。

translations.literal: When bandits rose in Jiangxi, Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin ordered Meng to join the campaign; wherever Meng went he plundered.
translations.idiomatic: When banditry erupted in Jiangxi, Censor-in-Chief Chen Jin ordered Meng to join the campaign, but Meng plundered wherever his troops marched.

sentences.zh: 然以賊平故論功，遷指揮同知。

translations.literal: Yet because the bandits were pacified he was nonetheless rewarded with promotion to Assistant Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because the rebels were suppressed, he was nonetheless rewarded with promotion to Assistant Commander.

sentences.zh: 非猛初意，頗犯望。

translations.literal: This was not what Meng had originally intended, and he was quite disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: This fell far short of what Meng had hoped for, and he was deeply disappointed.

sentences.zh: 正德十五年，猛奏：「田州土兵每征調，輒許戶留一二丁耕種，以供常稅。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhengde, Meng memorialized: "Whenever Tianzhou native troops are mobilized for campaign, each household is permitted to retain one or two men to farm, so as to supply regular taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhengde, Meng memorialized: "Whenever Tianzhou native troops are mobilized, each household is allowed to keep one or two men at home to farm and meet regular tax obligations.

sentences.zh: 其久勞於外者，乞量振給，免其輸稅。」

translations.literal: For those who have long served away from home, I beg that relief be granted in proportion and their tax payments waived."
translations.idiomatic: For those who have long served away from home, I beg that relief be granted in proportion and their tax payments waived."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年，猛率兵攻泗城，拔六寨，遂克州治。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing, Meng led troops to attack Sicheng, captured six stockades, and then seized the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiajing, Meng led troops against Sicheng, took six stockades, and finally captured the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 岑接告急於軍門，言猛無故興兵攻寨。

translations.literal: Cen Jie appealed urgently to headquarters, saying Meng had mobilized without cause to attack the stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Jie sent an urgent appeal to headquarters, reporting that Meng had attacked without provocation.

sentences.zh: 猛言接非岑氏後，據其祖業，欲得所侵地。

translations.literal: Meng claimed that Jie was not of Cen lineage, had seized his ancestors' estate, and that he sought to recover the encroached territory.
translations.idiomatic: Meng countered that Jie was not a true descendant of the Cen line but had usurped ancestral lands, and that he sought only to recover territory Jie had seized.

sentences.zh: 時方有上思州之役，征兵皆不至，總督張嵿以狀聞。

translations.literal: At the time the campaign against Shangsi Prefecture was underway; summoned troops none came; Governor-General Zhang Jing reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: A campaign against Shangsi Prefecture was then underway, yet none of the summoned troops reported for duty; Governor-General Zhang Jing reported the situation to the throne.

sentences.zh: 四年，提督盛應期、巡按謝汝儀議大征猛，條征調事宜，詔報可。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Supreme Commander Sheng Yingqi and Touring Censor Xie Ruyi proposed a major expedition against Meng, itemizing mobilization arrangements; an edict approved the plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Supreme Commander Sheng Yingqi and Touring Censor Xie Ruyi proposed a major expedition against Meng with detailed mobilization plans; the throne approved.

sentences.zh: 而應期以他事去，詔以都御史姚鏌代，命懸金購猛。

translations.literal: Yingqi departed on other business; an edict appointed Censor-in-Chief Yao Mo to replace him and ordered a bounty posted for Meng's capture.
translations.idiomatic: Yingqi was reassigned on other business; Yao Mo was appointed Censor-in-Chief in his place, and a bounty was posted for Meng's capture.

sentences.zh: 然鏌知猛無反心，猛方奏辯，鏌亦欲緩師。

translations.literal: Yet Mo knew Meng had no intention of rebellion; Meng was then memorializing in his own defense, and Mo also wished to slow the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Mo, however, believed Meng had no rebellious intent; Meng was petitioning in his own defense, and Mo himself favored delaying the campaign.

sentences.zh: 而巡按謝汝儀與鏌隙，乃誣鏌之子淶納猛萬金，廉得淶書獻之。
